slider.desc: Driven by personal tragedy, Hamza dives deeper into his deep-cover mission to ruin Pakistan's criminal underworld in this unseen sequel to "Dhurandhar."
Torn between duty and his loved ones, a police officer (Saif Ali Khan) investigates a high-profile murder while protecting his family. With Rasika Dugal.
Master con artist Berlin and his gang prepare to outdo even themselves with their latest high‑stakes heist: a priceless art robbery in Seville.

movies.title: Agneepath
movies.synopsis: A boy grows up to become a gangster in pursuit of the mobster who killed his innocent father, but revenge and reparation may come at great costs.

movies.title: The Godfather

movies.title: The Mummy Returns
movies.synopsis: Egyptologists unearth a prehistoric relic capable of releasing cataclysmic forces and satanic warriors led by the sinister Scorpion King.

movies.title: Dil Chahta Hai
movies.synopsis: Inseparable childhood friends Akash, Sameer and Siddharth are just out of college. Nothing comes between them -- until they each fall in love.

movies.title: Final Destination 2
movies.synopsis: On a road trip with friends, a young woman has a terrifying premonition, setting off a supernatural fight against fate with deadly consequences.

movies.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
movies.synopsis: Ben bets his coworkers that he can make a woman fall in love with him in just 10 days. But along comes Andie, a writer with her own agenda.

movies.title: Scarface
movies.synopsis: In a ruthless rise to Miami drug lord, a Cuban-born gangster descends into addiction, obsession and brutality, with grisly consequences.

movies.title: The Last Samurai
movies.synopsis: An American war veteran hired to teach modern military tactics in 1870s Japan becomes caught up in the conflict between the emperor and the samurai.

movies.title: Dawn of the Dead
movies.synopsis: As the dead rise to feast on the living, a group of survivors hides in a shopping mall. Zack Snyder directs this gory remake of the zombie classic.

movies.title: Cellular
movies.synopsis: A man answers his cell phone and hears a stranger who's desperate for someone to help her and her family escape a madman who's abducted them.

movies.title: Final Destination 3
movies.synopsis: After a teen’s terrifying premonition of a roller coaster crash saves her and several others, they all discover death doesn’t like to be cheated.
King Leonidas of Sparta leads 300 powerful warriors into an epic and bloody battle at Thermopylae against the massive invading forces of King Xerxes.

movies.title: No Reservations
movies.synopsis: After a perfectionist chef takes in her niece, an easygoing sous-chef disrupts her kitchen. Can they find the recipe for happiness, or will it boil over?

movies.title: Ta Ra Rum Pum
movies.synopsis: Living his dream as a race car driver, RV's world turns upside down when an accident puts his family on a challenging new road.

movies.title: Chak De! India
movies.synopsis: Kabir Khan was once a celebrated hockey player. Now, he's a disgraced outcast. Can he redeem himself by coaching the Indian women's team to victory?

movies.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
movies.synopsis: A hunch and the defunding of his laboratory prompt a geology professor to set off for Iceland in search of a portal to Earth's core.

movies.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
movies.synopsis: A young archaeologist unearths a cursed mummy and enlists his famous parents to return the evil force to its grave — before it takes over the world.
When a flood of natural disasters begins to destroy the world, a divorced dad desperately tries to save his family by outrunning the cataclysmic chaos.

movies.title: Orphan
movies.synopsis: Grieving a devastating loss, Kate and John adopt 9-year-old Esther — but Kate soon sees through the girl's angelic facade.

movies.title: The Final Destination
movies.synopsis: At a car race, teen Nick O’Bannon has a premonition that rescues him and several others from a horrifying fate… or so it seems.

movies.title: Dil Bole Hadippa!
movies.synopsis: To fulfill her dream of playing cricket professionally, spirited Veera disguises herself as a man and tries out for a struggling team.

movies.title: Dexter
movies.synopsis: Mild-mannered Dexter Morgan works for the police department as a blood-splatter analyst but moonlights as a murderer who only targets other killers.
movies.creator: James Manos Jr.

episodes.title: A Beautiful Day
episodes.description: Dexter is still managing life as a dad, brother and killer, as Miami Metro investigates the murder of a man who's had pieces of his brain removed.

episodes.title: Every Silver Lining...
episodes.description: Miami Metro continues hunting for the Brain Surgeon, while Dr. Vogel enlists Dexter's help. While on a case, Debra takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: What's Eating Dexter Morgan?
episodes.description: Dexter continues his search for the Brain Surgeon. Dr. Vogel tries to prove to Dexter that he's a perfect specimen. Debra's guilt begins to creep up.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.description: Dexter tracks down another potential killer from Dr. Vogel's list. Quinn celebrates passing the sergeant's exam by defending Debra's honor in a fight.

episodes.title: This Little Piggy
episodes.description: Dr. Vogel comes into contact with the Brain Surgeon, while Dexter and Debra try to keep her safe. Masuka finds out he has a daughter.

episodes.title: A Little Reflection
episodes.description: Dexter monitors a troubled young man. Dexter and Debra finally get back to normal, but they're surprised when someone from his past pays them a visit.

episodes.title: Dress Code
episodes.description: Dexter takes on a protégé and starts teaching him the Code.

episodes.title: Are We There Yet?
episodes.description: Dexter tracks down Zach, concerned that he may have murdered an innocent person. Meanwhile, Dexter tries to help Hannah escape the country.

episodes.title: Make Your Own Kind of Music
episodes.description: Dexter investigates a murder that hits close to home. Dr. Vogel gets the surprise of a lifetime when someone returns from her past.

episodes.title: Goodbye Miami
episodes.description: With Dr. Vogel's help, Dexter tries to lure the Brain Surgeon into a trap so he can get him on his table. Dexter witnesses a murder.

movies.title: Heroes
movies.synopsis: Ordinary people around the world discover they possess extraordinary abilities and race to stop a catastrophe that threatens to destroy New York City.
movies.creator: Tim Kring

episodes.title: Orientation/Jump, Push, Fall
episodes.description: As Claire begins college and Hiro launches a new business with Ando, a mysterious carnival with unknown intentions arrives in town.

episodes.title: Ink
episodes.description: As Claire navigates college life and the burden of her abilities, Peter meets a new hero while confronting the fallout of his past actions.

episodes.title: Acceptance
episodes.description: Hiro's health continues to deteriorate. Angela takes a gamble by helping the new Nathan regain his memory.

episodes.title: Hysterical Blindness
episodes.description: As Samuel builds his new family, Peter discovers a connection with Emma that changes how he sees his abilities.

episodes.title: Tabula Rasa
episodes.description: Sylar sets out to rediscover his identity under Samuel's guidance, while Claire's new roommate becomes increasingly dangerous.

episodes.title: Strange Attractors
episodes.description: Matt takes drastic action to stop Sylar from tormenting him. Meanwhile, Claire and Gretchen endure a string of pranks, and Noah steps in to help Jeremy.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time in Texas
episodes.description: When Hiro travels three years into the past, he has a second chance to save Charlie from the hands of Sylar.

episodes.title: Shadowboxing
episodes.description: Claire is determined to get to the bottom of the Sorority Rush attacks on her own, and Peter's new ability is a perfect fit for his job.

episodes.title: Brother's Keeper
episodes.description: As Samuel pushes his abilities to new extremes, Peter and Nathan confront painful truths about their family.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.description: Thanksgiving unites families and brings new revelations, as HRG hosts an untraditional holiday dinner.

movies.title: Housefull
movies.synopsis: Arush marries Devikah, hoping to escape a lifetime of misfortune — but their lavish honeymoon comes to an abrupt end when she leaves him for another man.

movies.title: Breaking Bad
movies.synopsis: A terminally ill chemistry teacher teams with a former student to manufacture crystal meth to secure his family's future.
movies.creator: Vince Gilligan

episodes.title: Live Free Or Die
episodes.description: Walt goes to see his family, still under guard, while dealing with the aftermath of the explosion at Casa Tranquila.

episodes.title: Madrigal
episodes.description: Walt and Jesse decide to look for a new partner to help them in their latest scheme. The DEA sifts through various leads, hoping to find something.

episodes.title: Hazard Pay
episodes.description: To Skyler's dismay, Walter moves back into the house. Walter, Mike and Jesse meet with Saul to talk about finding a new place to cook.

episodes.title: Fifty-One
episodes.description: As Lydia gives up her own employee to the DEA, Mike offers her a replacement: Jesse. Walt and Skyler argue about whether the family is safe.

episodes.title: Dead Freight
episodes.description: Mike and Lydia work to get the methylamine transported for the operation. Walt and Jesse try to come up with a plan that won't blow their cover.

episodes.title: Buyout
episodes.description: Walt, Mike and Jesse deal with the repercussions of the methylamine heist. Mike and Jesse want out, but Walt is determined to build his empire.

episodes.title: Say My Name
episodes.description: Walter tries to strike up a deal with Declan. Told to lay off Mike, Hank switches his focus to the lawyer who's been paying off Mike's men.

episodes.title: Gliding Over All
episodes.description: Walt meets with Lydia to get the names of Mike's people in prison. Skyler makes another attempt to convince Walt to give up cooking meth.

episodes.title: Blood Money
episodes.description: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.

episodes.title: Buried
episodes.description: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.

movies.title: The Mentalist
movies.synopsis: Golden Globe nominee Simon Baker stars as Patrick Jane, a former psychic who uses his understanding of human behavior to help break tough murder cases.
movies.creator: Bruno Heller

episodes.title: Nothing But Blue Skies
episodes.description: Jane and Lisbon try to keep their romance under wraps as they investigate the murder of an undercover agent and welcome a rookie to the team.

episodes.title: The Greybar Hotel
episodes.description: Lisbon goes undercover at a jail to get close to the girlfriend of a car thief who's wanted by the FBI and CIA.

episodes.title: Orange Blossom Ice Cream
episodes.description: Jane and Lisbon travel to Beirut on a high-stakes mission to capture a man linked to criminal groups — with help from their old adversary, Erica Flynn.

episodes.title: Black Market
episodes.description: As the team investigates a murder linked to a cache of stolen diamonds, a sick Jane coaches Lisbon through a psychic performance from afar.

episodes.title: The Silver Briefcase
episodes.description: After meeting a colonel who seems to have something to hide, Jane digs into the circumstances surrounding the murder of the man's wife.

episodes.title: Green Light
episodes.description: While consulting on a botched DEA raid, Abbott is blackmailed by his former boss and forced to choose between his career and his morals.

episodes.title: Little Yellow House
episodes.description: Lisbon takes Jane to her childhood home after learning that her underachieving younger brother is wanted as a key witness in a murder case.

episodes.title: The Whites of His Eyes
episodes.description: Jane worries for Lisbon's safety when the team puts itself in the line of fire to protect the witness in a murder investigation from a skilled assassin.

episodes.title: Copper Bullet
episodes.description: When Abbott's former boss threatens Lena's career in government, Jane launches a plan to protect his friend and expose corruption at the highest level.

episodes.title: Nothing Gold Can Stay
episodes.description: The team pursues a gang of armored car robbers, but the operation spirals dangerously. Jane goes to extremes to keep Lisbon out of harm's way.

movies.title: Hawaii Five-0
movies.synopsis: After returning home to investigate his father's murder, a naval officer accepts an offer to lead an elite, state-backed task force.
movies.creator: Leonard Freeman

episodes.title: A'ohe Kahi E Pe'e Ai (Nowhere to Hide)
episodes.description: The island is on lockdown as Five-0 hunts a tech-savvy strategist weaponizing drones. McGarrett and Danny consult a psychologist for a profile.

episodes.title: 'Ka Makuakane (Family Man)
episodes.description: The young daughter of a Navy SEAL serving in Afghanistan is kidnapped. Meanwhile, Danny must come up with $18.5 million to free his captive brother.

episodes.title: Kanalu Hope Loa (The Last Break)
episodes.description: Five-0 intervenes after a group of thieves unknowingly steals a lethal asset, sparking a deadly pursuit by an assassin desperate to reclaim it.

episodes.title: Ka No'eau (The Painter)
episodes.description: Chin takes a big risk to help Danny get the money he needs to save his brother's life. McGarrett hunts for a brazen mob killer with a strange motive.

episodes.title: Ho'oilina (Legacy)
episodes.description: A defense lawyer's casual comment leads McGarrett to new evidence that may help him crack his father's last unsolved case.

episodes.title: Ho'oma'ike (Unmasked)
episodes.description: On Halloween, Five-0 hunts a killer mimicking an obscure slasher film. McGarrett and Danny help Jerry gather evidence against Farrow.

episodes.title: Ina Paha (If Perhaps)
episodes.description: After Wo Fat abducts and drugs him, McGarrett experiences a vivid hallucination of an alternate life where his father is still alive.

episodes.title: Ka Hana Malu (Inside Job)
episodes.description: When murder befalls a banker and his wife, their sons are the chief suspects. Meanwhile, McGarrett's Aunt Deb comes back to Hawaii, but she's not alone.

episodes.title: Ke Koho Mamao Aku (Longshot)
episodes.description: At Christmas, the team goes to the Big Island to solve a cowboy's murder. While Max works with an old rival, McGarrett gives Danny a quirky assignment.

episodes.title: Wawahi moe'uhane (Broken Dreams)
episodes.description: An officer-turned-private detective teams up with Five-0 to untangle a murder tied to a local dance company that conceals illegal activity.

movies.title: Final Destination 5
movies.synopsis: On a trip with his coworkers, a man has a terrifying vision of an imminent and catastrophic bridge collapse. Lives are saved... but not for long.

movies.title: Quarantine 2: Terminal
movies.synopsis: In this gory sequel, terrified passengers attempt to survive as a deadly virus rips through a plane while ground control races to contain the crisis.

movies.title: Person of Interest
movies.synopsis: Elusive billionaire Harold Finch (Michael Emerson) hires a former CIA spy (Jim Caviezel) to prevent violent crimes using his powerful surveillance AI.
movies.creator: Jonathan Nolan

episodes.title: B.S.O.D.
episodes.description: After the initiation of "the Correction," Root faces a potentially futile fight. Meanwhile, Reese and Finch search for the Machine's source code.

episodes.title: SNAFU
episodes.description: A glitch causes the Machine to identify dozens of people not involved in crimes, and Reese and Finch themselves become targets.

episodes.title: Truth Be Told
episodes.description: The latest POI investigates the death of his brother, whom Reese was assigned to kill during his time with the CIA.
Shaw escapes Decima's psychological conditioning, but persistent symptoms and paranoia make her wonder if her freedom is part of a larger plan.

episodes.title: ShotSeeker
episodes.description: Reese protects an NYPD analyst falling down a deadly technological rabbit hole. Digging too deep, Fusco becomes a Samaritan target.

episodes.title: A More Perfect Union
episodes.description: The Machine leads the team to a deceptively simple wedding that involves a deadly plot to target one of the guests.

episodes.title: QSO
episodes.description: Root tracks a signal to a conspiracy theory radio station, where she discovers a key to Samaritan's covert operations.

episodes.title: Reassortment
episodes.description: Reese and Finch struggle to escape a hospital after Samaritan synthesizes a lethal virus. Shaw plans her own escape from what could be a simulation.

episodes.title: Sotto Voce
episodes.description: The mastermind known as "the Voice" returns, and an armed group besieges the precinct, trapping Reese and Fusco inside.

episodes.title: The Day the World Went Away
episodes.description: The team rallies to protect Finch after Samaritan agents uncover his identity — and swiftly launch a series of escalating attacks to hunt him down.

movies.title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
movies.synopsis: Three friends on an adventurous road trip/bachelor party in Spain learn some lessons about themselves and each other that will change them forever.

movies.title: Bleach
movies.synopsis: After teenager Ichigo Kurosaki acquires superpowers from wounded soul reaper Rukia Kuchiki, the two of them join forces to round up lost souls.

episodes.title: The Blood Warfare
episodes.description: In Karakura, two newly appointed Soul Reapers nearly die while facing several powerful Hollows — until some veteran combatants come to their aid.

episodes.title: Foundation Stones
episodes.description: Ichigo and the others learn of the damage caused by the mysterious attack on Soul Society. Later, Ichigo encounters Nel, who begs him for help.

episodes.title: March of The Starcross
episodes.description: In Soul Society, Yamamoto orders all the squad captains to prepare for war with the Quincies. Meanwhile, Ichigo duels Quilge Opie in Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: Kill The Shadow
episodes.description: The Soul Reapers fail to stop the Stern Ritters' incursion into the Seireitei, leading to heavy casualties. The squad captains take to the front line.

episodes.title: Wrath As A Lightning
episodes.description: Trapped within Quilge Opie's barrier, Ichigo can only listen to the cries of his comrades. Meanwhile, Byakuya faces Äs Nödt, who stole his bankai.

episodes.title: The Fire
episodes.description: Amid roaring flames, Yamamoto and Yhwach face each other for the first time in a thousand years, beginning a vicious and fateful battle.

episodes.title: Born In The Dark
episodes.description: After the duel, Yhwach describes how Yamamoto and the once-dreaded 13 Court Guard Squads have changed. He then orders the destruction of Soul Society.

episodes.title: The Shooting Star Project[ZERO MIX]
episodes.description: As the denizens of Seireitei tend to their wounded, Ichigo meets the members of the elite Squad 0, who have come to take him to Soul King Palace.

episodes.title: The Drop
episodes.description: After Ichigo and Renji recover from their injuries, Kirio treats them to a feast. Newly appointed Head Captain Kyoraku meets with the Council of 46.

episodes.title: The Battle
episodes.description: Continuing their intense battle, Kenpachi and Unohana recall the day they first met. Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji meet the man who created zanpakuto.

movies.title: Naruto
movies.synopsis: Guided by the spirit demon within him, orphaned Naruto learns to harness his powers as a ninja in this anime adventure series.

episodes.title: Vanished Memories
episodes.description: Naruto comes across an injured young man who has lost his memory. Impressed by his kindness, Naruto insists on letting him stay in the village.

episodes.title: Bringing Back Reality
episodes.description: Tsunade thinks Menma is connected to the Hidden Sound Village, so Naruto and the others head for the Land of Rice Paddies to check into his memories.

episodes.title: A Past to Be Erased
episodes.description: Just as the angry villagers are about to attack Menma, the bandits strike again and accuse him of being a traitor to their gang.

episodes.title: The Village of Artisans: The Targeted Shukaku
episodes.description: A mysterious group called the Four Celestials kidnaps ninja candidate Matsuri. Tsunade receives a request for help from the Sand.

episodes.title: The Village of Artisans: Sand Alliance with the Leaf Shinobi
episodes.description: Shikamaru sends Shino, Hinata and Neji to search for the enemy while the Shikamaru squad waits for the right moment to attack.

episodes.title: The Village of Artisans: The Counterattack!
episodes.description: Although Gaara seems to be gaining ground on his opponents, he is slowly being drawn into a trap and gets caught in their secret jutsu.

episodes.title: The Village of Artisans: The Ultimate Weapon Reborn
episodes.description: Gaara and Naruto corner Hoko, the last of the Four Celestials, in a gully. He reveals that they were once shinobi from the Village of Artisans.

episodes.title: The Village of Artisans: Departure
episodes.description: Gaara transforms into Shukaku the Sand Spirit and manages an impressive win. After the battle, Naruto sets off on a training journey with Jiraiya.

movies.title: The Dictator
movies.synopsis: Sacha Baron Cohen stars as a misogynistic tyrant who ends up on the streets of New York, powerless, unrecognizable and working in an organic food co-op.

movies.title: Chennai Express
movies.synopsis: What could have been a sad journey turns joyful for Rahul when he falls in love with a woman en route to submerging his grandfather's ashes.

movies.title: Jab Tak Hai Jaan
movies.synopsis: A fearless yet reserved army officer must confront his painful past and lost love when a journalist enters his life.

movies.title: Talaash
movies.synopsis: Set in the jumbled landscape of Mumbai, this mystery drama centers on a police inspector who's trying to cope with the collapse of his marriage.

movies.title: Man of Steel
movies.synopsis: Drifter Clark Kent must keep his powers hidden from the world, but when an evil general plans to destroy Earth, the Man of Steel springs into action.

movies.title: The Purge
movies.synopsis: For one night a year, all crime in America — even murder — becomes legal. Can one family survive until dawn when masked assailants target their home?

movies.title: The Call
movies.synopsis: A 911 operator (Halle Berry) races to save a kidnapped teenager after she realizes the abductor is the same man responsible for a previous murder.

movies.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
movies.synopsis: Mortal-turned-god Xerxes is back, leading the Persian forces in their invasion of Greece.

movies.title: The Purge: Anarchy
movies.synopsis: In a dystopian future America, five people try to survive an annual night of mayhem when any criminal act can be committed without consequences.

movies.title: Naruto Shippuden
movies.synopsis: After training abroad for more than two years, Naruto Uzumaki returns home and joins forces with Sakura Haruno to battle an evil organization.

episodes.title: Naruto and Hinata
episodes.description: Flashback to Naruto's and Hinata's childhood. Although their fates may seem opposed, they are both marked by an immense loneliness.

episodes.title: Sasuke and Sakura
episodes.description: While Sasuke and Sakura are still in elementary school at the Academy, they have already fallen prey to the first torments of life.

episodes.title: Gaara and Shikamaru
episodes.description: Gaara understands early on that he's not an ordinary child. Already disillusioned, despite his age, Shikamaru discovers the virtues of friendship.

episodes.title: Jiraiya and Kakashi
episodes.description: We return to the childhood years of Orochimaru, Tsunade and Jiraya, as well as Kakashi, Obito and Lin, when these young shinobis were still innocent.

episodes.title: The Exploding Human
episodes.description: The villagers who were reported missing and have been rendered unconscious, come back to Konoha to blow themselves up. Kakashi decides to call Sasuke.

episodes.title: Coliseum
episodes.description: Looking for answers about the human bombs, Sasuke goes to meet Orochimaru who takes him to a mysterious island.

episodes.title: Fūshin
episodes.description: Sasuke finally finds the arms dealer who once had a fighter with special powers in his service. Will he be able to solve the human bomb mystery?

episodes.title: The Ketsuryūgan
episodes.description: After dealing with Fushin, Sasuke finds traces of Chino. She reveals her mysterious past to him in the Valley of Hell.

episodes.title: The Last One
episodes.description: The last two survivors of their clans clash in the Valley of Hell. Will the Uchiwa and the Chinoike disappear from shinobi history?

episodes.title: The State of Affairs
episodes.description: Kakashi is named 6th Hokage, Naruto is preparing to use his power, and Shikamaru seems preoccupied by an investigation into missing persons.

movies.title: Stranger Things
movies.synopsis: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and one strange little girl.
movies.creator: The Duffer Brothers

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.description: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of...
episodes.description: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.description: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.description: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Shock Jock
episodes.description: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
episodes.description: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
episodes.description: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.description: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

movies.title: Dil Dhadakne Do
movies.synopsis: While hosting a shipboard holiday for relatives and friends, a wealthy but dysfunctional family must face the ugly truths under their flawless facade.

movies.title: Lucifer
movies.synopsis: Bored with being the Lord of Hell, the devil relocates to Los Angeles, where he opens a nightclub and forms a connection with a homicide detective.

episodes.title: Nothing Ever Changes Around Here
episodes.description: Before Lucifer starts his new job, he and Chloe experience a magical night with a murderous end. Linda and Amenadiel host Maze and Eve for dinner.

episodes.title: Buckets of Baggage
episodes.description: Desperate to be helpful, Lucifer assists an exasperated Carol investigate a drag queen's death. Ella and Chloe look into Carol’s mysterious background.

episodes.title: Yabba Dabba Do Me
episodes.description: Loony Lucifer and cartoon Chloe find themselves trapped in an animated loop. Amenadiel prepares for his new job. Dan returns to the city of angels.

episodes.title: Pin the Tail on the Daddy
episodes.description: Lucifer reconnects with a few former flames in hopes of disproving Rory's claim. Dan tries to find someone — anyone — who can actually see him.

episodes.title: The Murder of Lucifer Morningstar
episodes.description: Not believing that he could have abandoned his future daughter, Lucifer sets out to prove an alternate theory: He must have been murdered.

episodes.title: A Lot Dirtier Than That
episodes.description: Wanting to do well on his first day with the LAPD, Amenadiel crosses paths with a racist detective from his past. Also, Lucifer tries to bond with Rory.

episodes.title: My Best Fiend's Wedding
episodes.description: Just as Eve and Maze's wedding day arrives, Eve's ex, Adam — yes, that Adam — shows up hoping to reconcile. Later, Ella delivers some distressing news.

episodes.title: Save the Devil, Save the World
episodes.description: Lucifer says he's finally ready to be God, but his non-functioning wings would tend to disagree. Linda reluctantly shares the first draft of her book.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Lucifer
episodes.description: Lucifer tries to enjoy what may be his last day on Earth, Dan's killer escapes from prison, and Chloe drops a serious bombshell.

episodes.title: Partners 'Til the End
episodes.description: Desperate to rescue Rory, Lucifer and Chloe confront her kidnapper with guns and wings blazing. Lucifer finally comes to terms with his purpose.

movies.title: C.I.D
movies.synopsis: A team of dedicated men and women in the Crime Investigation Department will risk everything to solve Mumbai's toughest, most complicated crimes.

episodes.title: 07-09-2025 A Serial Killer's Revenge
episodes.description: When a fearsome serial killer escapes, the team must track him down before he takes revenge on those who put him behind bars.

episodes.title: 13-09-2025 Shooting Stars
episodes.description: A young man's romantic proposal under the stars turns into a deadly nightmare. Was he killed by a celestial force — or is there a darker mystery at work?

episodes.title: 14-09-2025 High Security Murder
episodes.description: When Abhijeet learns that his friend Dhanraaj may be in danger, he rushes to find him, navigating an intense security system.

episodes.title: 20-09-2025 The Missing Influencer
episodes.description: A social media stunt at an abandoned amusement park turns sinister when an influencer vanishes, drawing the CID into a chilling case.

episodes.title: 21-09-2025 Attack On Mumbai
episodes.description: A man reports a threat to his life and an impending attack in Mumbai. Before he can say more, he collapses and dies. Now, the team must find the truth.

episodes.title: 27-09-2025 Death During A Live Stream
episodes.description: When Shanaya doesn't respond to her family, CID finds her dead in her apartment and investigates current and former boyfriends to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: 28-09-2025 Pariyon Ki Duniya
episodes.description: The CID faces a baffling case involving possession, talk of fairyland and suicide, leading to a complex mystery.

episodes.title: 04-10-2025 A Poisoned Necklace
episodes.description: An engagement ceremony turns tragic when the bride is found dead. The team hunts for the killer after tracing the murder to a poisoned necklace.

episodes.title: 05-10-2025 Curious Case Of Artificial Intelligence
episodes.description: The kidnapping of a cricketer's daughter from her school leads the CID through a high-pressure investigation to crack the case.

episodes.title: 11-10-2025 Murder At The Resort
episodes.description: A nightmare unfolds at a resort when a young woman is found stabbed to death. The CID questions her friends, seeking the truth behind the murder.

movies.title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
movies.synopsis: When Prem and Sandhya get married, sparks don't exactly fly. But running in a partnered footrace may be just the thing they need to ignite their flame.

movies.title: Lights Out
movies.synopsis: A family is haunted by a sinister entity that lurks in the dark in this horror film produced by James Wan ("Annabelle").

movies.title: Detective Conan
movies.synopsis: A boy with the brainpower of a brilliant adult, Conan Edogawa can close any case — because there is always only one truth!

episodes.title: Taiko Meijin's Shogi Board (The Opening Move)
episodes.description: While pondering over the murder of a shogi player accused of match-fixing, Conan and his friends meet Shukichi Haneda, who is on his way to a meeting.

episodes.title: Taiko Meijin's Shogi Board (The Brilliant Move)
episodes.description: When Conan and the others investigate the body found at Shukichi's shogi study group apartment, a fire breaks out at another member's house.

episodes.title: Taiko Meijin's Shogi Board (The Checkmate)
episodes.description: Conan mulls over the alibis of each of the shogi study group members as he and Shuichi Akai track down where Shukichi is being held.

episodes.title: Whiteout (Part 1)
episodes.description: Professor Agasa takes the Detective Boys to a ski resort. On the way, they help out a group of travelers whose car is stuck in the snow.

episodes.title: Whiteout (Part 2)
episodes.description: With Ayumi having witnessed a murder, the Detective Boys try to evade their pursuers while desperately calling for rescue in the growing snowstorm.

episodes.title: The Flying Jack-o'-lantern
episodes.description: At Café Poirot, Conan sees Azusa making a jack-o'-lantern. According to her, rumors of a "pumpkin ghost" have recently been spreading around town.

episodes.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 2
episodes.description: While on their way home, Conan and his friends notice a building's light flashing out an SOS message in Morse code. They rush to investigate.

episodes.title: The Unstated Alibi
episodes.description: After falling down a temple's steps, an old lady claims a young woman pushed her. Conan keenly observes a suspicious man watching from an alleyway.

episodes.title: The Figure of Revenge
episodes.description: The Detective Boys are shown around a university's figurine club. However, things become unstuck as tensions rise amongst its members.

episodes.title: The Deadly Pork Soup Signal
episodes.description: A woman is found dead in her apartment. Conan takes an interest in the police investigation, which suggests a notorious figure may be responsible.

movies.title: Sultan
movies.synopsis: After hitting rock bottom, a retired wrestler with a once-promising career seeks to make amends for his past mistakes through an inspiring comeback.

movies.title: Lost in Space
movies.synopsis: After crash-landing on an alien planet, the Robinson family fights against all odds to survive and escape. But they're surrounded by hidden dangers.

episodes.title: Three Little Birds
episodes.description: A year into their mission with the children of the Resolute, Judy, Penny and Will scramble to find the titanium they need to get to Alpha Centauri.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.description: While Judy sets out to find Grant Kelly, Penny and Will explore a mysterious tunnel. Light years away, Maureen, John and Don hunt for SAR's remains.

episodes.title: The New Guy
episodes.description: Scarecrow helps Maureen and John plot an engine heist. Judy returns to camp with new passengers. Will makes a startling discovery in the alien city.

episodes.title: Nothing Left Behind
episodes.description: As the adults race to destroy all clues to the location of Alpha Centauri, the Robinson kids receive an ominous message from SAR.

episodes.title: Stuck
episodes.description: After crashing on a boggy planet, Maureen and Judy contend with a massive salivating creature, while John and Penny work to free the trapped Robot.

episodes.title: Final Transmission
episodes.description: The story of Don's run-in with SAR leads the Robinsons to an alarming realization. Will sneaks out on a dangerous solo mission.

episodes.title: Contingencies on Contingencies
episodes.description: The Robinsons race to get help for Will, warn the other colonists and activate a secret defense system. Vijay tags along with Penny on a risky outing.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.description: As the battle for Alpha Centauri unfolds, the Robinsons and their friends risk everything to restore peace and pave the way for a better future.

movies.title: ONE PIECE
movies.synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy sails with his crew of Straw Hat Pirates through the Grand Line to find the treasure One Piece and become the new king of the pirates.

episodes.title: Episode 1123
episodes.description: Six days after Lulusia's destruction, an earthquake causes chaos throughout the world. Meanwhile, Admiral Kizaru's forces have surrounded Egghead.

episodes.title: Episode 1124
episodes.description: Using York as a bargaining chip, Luffy tries forcing a deal with the marines to let the Straw Hats leave Egghead. Both groups plan their next move.

episodes.title: Episode 1125
episodes.description: Kizaru and Sentomaru's fierce battle continues. As the marines make landfall, Dr. Vegapunk and his Satellites desperately work to crack the code.

episodes.title: Episode 1126
episodes.description: Sakazuki attempts to thwart Kuma's assault on Mary Geoise. In the present, Luffy continues trying to prevent Kizaru from reaching Vegapunk.

episodes.title: Episode 1127
episodes.description: As Luffy holds off Kizaru, Vegapunk and the other Straw Hats set out to regain control of the Pacifistas, rescue Bonney and escape from Egghead.

episodes.title: Episode 1128
episodes.description: As the Pacifistas begin attacking the Marines, Sanji and the others hurry down the island clouds toward the Fabriophase in search of Bonney.

episodes.title: Episode 1129
episodes.description: Unfazed by Bonney's attack, St. Saturn overwhelms her and the others. In the past, a young Kuma and his parents are captured by government agents.

episodes.title: Episode 1130
episodes.description: Pirates invade God Valley after hearing about the Local-Hunting Competition. Kuma and his friends set out to steal the Devil Fruit prizes and escape.

episodes.title: Episode 1131
episodes.description: Kuma lives as a pastor with Ginny in Sorbet Kingdom and heals the older residents. Years later, the king begins forcing people into servitude.

episodes.title: Episode 1132
episodes.description: Following Ginny's abduction, Kuma continues fighting alongside the Revolutionary Army. Two years later, Ginny suddenly contacts Kuma and his comrades.

movies.title: Fauda
movies.synopsis: A top Israeli agent comes out of retirement to hunt for a Palestinian fighter he thought he'd killed, setting a chaotic chain of events into motion.
movies.creator: Lior Raz, Avi Issacharoff

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: In the aftermath of October 7, 2023, Eli and his friend Salem travel to Marseille on a personal vendetta. Fearing a deadly outcome, Doron pursues them.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: While evading the French police, Doron reluctantly agrees with Eli to fulfil his unsanctioned mission. Former Hamas commander Maher receives a warning.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: An impulsive decision puts Doron in a dangerous position. As Gabi works on an extraction plan, troubling intel pulls the team into an off-grid operation.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Eli and Doron take on a risky task to prove their loyalty while undercover. Israeli agent Steve faces blackmail from a detective with ulterior motives.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: After impressing a high-ranking Hamas official, Eli and Doron join an overseas envoy bound for a training camp, only to be kidnapped by an armed unit.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: The walls close in as Eli and Doron attempt to extract intel about an impending attack. Maher's wife Anne struggles with the realities of a rash decision.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: On October 7, 2023, an unprecedented attack pulls Eli into the field. As the ambush intensifies, Eli calls Doron to ensure his family's safety.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Under heavy fire, Eli tries to save an injured colleague as the events of October 7 unfold. Doron and Steve face an impossible choice.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: In the present, Shin Bet's tactical team makes a shocking discovery during a night raid. Gali confronts Dana and Gabi about Doron's safety.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Running out of time, Shin Bet enlists Steve to track down Doron, Saeed and the training camp envoy before they reach their destination.

movies.title: Overlord
movies.synopsis: In 2138, the last player of the online game Yggdrasil somehow stays logged in after its shutdown. Now he's on a quest to learn what happened and why.

episodes.title: Ainz Ooal Gown Nation of Leading Darkness
episodes.description: Unsure how to lead his kingdom, Sorcerer King Ainz goes over some proposals from the people of Nazarick with Albedo, who offers her blunt opinions.

episodes.title: Re-Estize kingdom
episodes.description: Returning to the royal palace, Princess Renner tells a troubled Prince Zanac that a diplomatic delegation from the Sorcerer Kingdom will arrive soon.

episodes.title: Baharuth Empire
episodes.description: Stressed about the threat of the Sorcerer Kingdom, Emperor Jircniv secretly plans to propose an alliance between his empire and the Slane Theocracy.

episodes.title: The Ruler of Conspiracy
episodes.description: Intent on recruiting adventurers for his kingdom, Ainz visits the imperial capital and duels with an infamous gladiator known as the Warrior King.

episodes.title: In Pursuit of the Land of Dwarves
episodes.description: Hoping to establish friendly relations and get his hands on rune technology, Ainz embarks on a journey to the kingdom of the dwarves.

episodes.title: The Impending Crisis
episodes.description: With the Quagoa bearing down on a dwarven stronghold and the dwarves on the verge of abandoning it, Ainz arrives and offers to assist in its defense.

episodes.title: Frost Dragon Lord
episodes.description: Wanting to even the odds against the surprisingly resilient dwarves, the Quagoa clan leader Riyuro asks a group of frost dragons for assistance.

episodes.title: An Unexpected Move
episodes.description: While Zanac ponders the situation facing his realm, Philip comes up with a plan to force the Sorcerer Kingdom to lower its production of food crops.

episodes.title: Countdown to Extinction
episodes.description: The Sorceror Kingdom declares war on Re-Estize and gives it one month to prepare. Those aware of Ainz's power steel themselves for the coming fight.

episodes.title: The Last King
episodes.description: After the movement of Ainz's forces becomes clear, Zanac decides to call his people to arms. Meanwhile, the Blue Roses receive a special request.

movies.title: My Hero Academia
movies.synopsis: After he saves a bully from a Villain, a normal student is granted a superpower that allows him to attend a high school training academy for Heroes.

episodes.title: The End of an Era, And -
episodes.description: Stain arrives to assist All Might against All For One, but his Bloodcurdle Quirk and All Might's secret weapon may not be enough to finish the fight.

episodes.title: The Final Boss!!
episodes.description: Having been revived from cardiac arrest, Bakugo launches an attack at All For One in a bid to prevent him from tearing All Might to pieces.

episodes.title: Quirk: Explosion!!
episodes.description: While fighting Bakugo, All For One sees in him traces of the second wielder of One For All — the one who took his brother Yoichi away long ago.

episodes.title: History’s Greatest Villain
episodes.description: Harnessing the power of One For All, Izuku barely manages to hold his own against Shigaraki, who reaches out and steals one of his Quirks.

episodes.title: Wrench It Open, Izuku Midoriya!!
episodes.description: Izuku attempts the risky plan to forcefully transfer the power of One For All into Shigaraki and make a direct attack on his mental scars.

episodes.title: From Aizawa
episodes.description: Inside Shigaraki's mind, Izuku witnesses the tragedy caused by the young Tenko Shimura. He grabs the boy's hands and speaks words of encouragement.

episodes.title: Izuku Midoriya Rising
episodes.description: Just when Izuku is on the verge of defeat, his classmates, Aizawa and the other heroes rush to his aid. His and the heroes' final battle begins.

episodes.title: Epilogue, the Hellish Todoroki Family: Final
episodes.description: Thanks to the encouragement of his friends and people around the world, Izuku has won. In the aftermath, the Todoroki family confronts Dabi.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Loves Smiles
episodes.description: Society begins to change in the wake of the battle. At the start of a new school year at UA, Izuku notices something odd about Ochaco’s demeanor.

movies.title: Dragon Ball Z
movies.synopsis: Now happily married and with a son, martial arts champion Goku must defend Earth from a series of extraterrestrial invaders bent on destruction.

episodes.title: The Gekiretsu Kodan That Split the Heavens!! Piccolo vs. Artificial Human No. 17
episodes.description: Piccolo engages the Androids when they arrive at Kame House. As the Namekian fights Android 17, Cell senses his tremendous power and heads their way.

episodes.title: How I Have Waited for This Day!! Cell's Prologue to Perfection
episodes.description: Piccolo provides a greater challenge than Android 17 expected, but he eventually tires. Bulma finishes a remote that can deactivate the Androids.

episodes.title: The Suicide Counterattack Proves Ineffective! Piccolo's Flame Burns Out!!
episodes.description: Needing to absorb Android 17 and Android 18 to attain his perfect form, Cell attacks. Piccolo is no match for him, even with his newly acquired power.

episodes.title: One Final Remaining Hope... No. 16, the Wordless Warrior, Takes Action!!
episodes.description: After defeating Piccolo with ease, Cell shifts his attention to absorbing Android 17. Just when it looks like Cell will succeed, someone intervenes.

episodes.title: No. 17 Swallowed... The Transforming Cell is a Super Gourmet
episodes.description: Things look bright when Android 16 lights up Cell with his ultimate technique. But hope dims when Cell ends up using the attack to his advantage.

episodes.title: Tomorrow, I Am Going to Pulverize You!! Goku's Challenge
episodes.description: Tien Shinhan blasts Cell with his Tri-Beam so Android 18 and Android 16 can escape. Goku appears just in time to save him from Cell’s wrath.

episodes.title: I Will Dispose of Everything!! A Reborn Vegeta, Father and Son, Sally Forth
episodes.description: Vegeta and Trunks complete their training, so Goku and Gohan take their turn in the Chamber. Cell continues his relentless search for the Androids.

episodes.title: Suddenly Full-Throttle!! The Super Power of a Radiant Vegeta
episodes.description: Android 16 and Android 18 hide from Cell on a deserted island. Just when they’re about to be discovered, the powered up Vegeta arrives ready to fight.

episodes.title: On Your Knees, Cell! I Am Super Vegeta!!
episodes.description: Even in his second form, Cell is no match for a powered-up Vegeta. Krillin arrives with the remote Bulma built to deactivate the Androids.

episodes.title: Dangerous Pride!! A Challenge to Cell's Perfect Form
episodes.description: Vegeta doesn't even see the much-weaker Cell as a threat. Frustrated and enraged, Cell yearns to acquire his perfect form.

movies.title: Dangal
movies.synopsis: A once-promising wrestler pursues the gold medal he never won by training two of his daughters to compete at the Commonwealth Games.

movies.title: S.W.A.T.
movies.synopsis: In his hometown of Los Angeles, a sergeant is tasked with leading an elite team of officers — and defusing deadly tensions in his community.

episodes.title: Vanished
episodes.description: When a masked gang abducts a school bus driver and the children onboard, the LAPD races to rescue them before the situation turns deadly.

episodes.title: Gang Unit
episodes.description: After clashing over a case's jurisdiction, 20-Squad works with the sheriff's Gang Suppression Unit to solve it. Gamble's history stirs up friction.

episodes.title: Life
episodes.description: The squad's prison hostage intervention ends with escapes, and Hicks butts heads with the facility's warden over how he handles things.

episodes.title: The Sepulveda Protocol
episodes.description: As Hondo and Gamble provide security for the LA mayor, a citywide power outage prompts Hicks to put all available SWAT officers on patrol to curb crime.

episodes.title: Human Interest
episodes.description: While dealing with a potential power play by Deputy Chief Bennett, Hicks suspects the cartel is responsible for kidnapping Victor's girlfriend.

episodes.title: Hot Button
episodes.description: Investigating the deaths of two medical professionals, the squad uncovers a doxing campaign targeting employees of abortion clinics.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.description: Deacon protects two college students who have armed stalkers and brings in the LAPD. Meanwhile, Gamble helps Victor fix the car he accidentally damaged.

episodes.title: Left Of Boom
episodes.description: Tracking down a stolen truck hauling radioactive cargo, 20-Squad suspects an extremist group behind the heist after identifying its passengers.

episodes.title: Open Season
episodes.description: After Gamble learns of a threat against someone in 20-Squad, she races to warn the team. Meanwhile, Powell tries to help an old friend.

episodes.title: The Heights
episodes.description: When a truck stop pat-down ends in a shoot-out, 20-Squad investigates and uncovers a drug smuggling operation using a pop star's tour vehicles.

movies.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
movies.synopsis: Multiple generations of the Joestar family -- all with the same nickname -- confront supernatural villains through a series of time periods.

episodes.title: Stone Ocean
episodes.description: Jolyne Cujoh is framed for a crime and sent to prison. When she touches a pendant she received from her father, a mysterious power begins to awaken.

episodes.title: Prisoner FE40536: Jolyne Cujoh
episodes.description: Jolyne begins her life in prison, but her erratic cellmate causes a major problem when she uses Jolyne's pendant to awaken her own Stand ability.

episodes.title: The Visitor (1)
episodes.description: Jolyne encounters a strange boy who warns her not to meet with a future visitor. The next day, her father Jotaro Kujo comes to see her.

episodes.title: The Visitor (2)
episodes.description: Jotaro tells Jolyne that Johngalli A., a former minion of DIO, is behind the recent events. Before she can react, Johngalli A.'s stand attacks them.

episodes.title: Prisoner of Love
episodes.description: Jotaro and Jolyne awake from the dream that the enemy Stand had shown them. After they escape the visitation room, a new enemy creeps toward them.

episodes.title: Ermes’s Stickers
episodes.description: Jolyne decides to return to the prison to retrieve Jotaro's discs. An odd male prisoner appears before Ermes Costello, who has also awakened a Stand.

episodes.title: There’s Six of Us!
episodes.description: Hoping to locate Pale Snake's discs, Ermes and Jolyne join a search party for two missing inmates. During the search, Ermes notices something strange.

episodes.title: F.F.
episodes.description: Ermes and Jolyne face off against the Stand that attacked the search party: F.F., a mass of plankton that has been granted intelligence by Pale Snake.

episodes.title: Debt Collector Mary Lynn Manson
episodes.description: F.F. borrows the appearance of a dead inmate to be around Jolyne and Ermes. While they play catch one day, another inmate approaches them with a bet.

episodes.title: Operation Savage Guardian (Head to the Courtyard!) (1)
episodes.description: Jolyne must quickly evade security and hand Jotaro's Stand disc over to the Speedwagon Foundation. Emporio appears and leads her to a mysterious room.

movies.title: The Haunting of Hill House
movies.synopsis: Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it.
movies.creator: Mike Flanagan

episodes.title: Steven Sees a Ghost
episodes.description: While investigating a ghost story for his latest novel, a skeptical Steven receives a call from his sister that triggers a chain of fateful events.

episodes.title: Open Casket
episodes.description: A devastating family tragedy stirs memories of traumatic losses, reminding Shirley of her first brush with death -- and awakening long-dormant fears.

episodes.title: Touch
episodes.description: Keenly perceptive Theo sees shades of herself in a troubled young patient, a girl who's haunted by the menacing grin of "Mr. Smiley."

episodes.title: The Twin Thing
episodes.description: Still wrestling with addiction -- and an unshakable fright -- a frantic Luke tries to save a friend while sensing his twin sister is in danger.

episodes.title: The Bent-Neck Lady
episodes.description: A dark specter with an unsettling silhouette has haunted Nell since she was a girl. Now "the Bent-Neck Lady" is back -- and she's calling Nell home.

episodes.title: Two Storms
episodes.description: It's a reunion for all the wrong reasons when Hugh flies in for the funeral, coming face to face with his estranged children on a dark, stormy night.

episodes.title: Eulogy
episodes.description: As the Crains gather to say their final goodbyes, a flashback reveals Mr. Dudley's connection to the house -- and exposes a secret in the walls.

episodes.title: Witness Marks
episodes.description: A familiar terror revisits Shirley and Theo on Halloween night as Hugh and Steve go looking for Luke, who disappeared on a deadly errand.

episodes.title: Screaming Meemies
episodes.description: While struggling to discern dreams from reality, Olivia fears for her children's safety, a motherly instinct Mrs. Dudley urges her to embrace.

episodes.title: Silence Lay Steadily
episodes.description: The Red Room's contents are finally revealed as the Crains return to the house to confront old ghosts, unspeakable secrets and an insatiable evil.

movies.title: The Witcher
movies.synopsis: Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster-hunter for hire, journeys toward his destiny in a turbulent world where people often prove more wicked than beasts.
movies.creator: Lauren Schmidt Hissrich

episodes.title: What Doesn't Kill You Makes You Stronger
episodes.description: Geralt sets out to save Ciri from the claws of Emhyr, unaware of her true fate. Beset by Vilgefortz, Yennefer attempts to uncover his plan.

episodes.title: Dream of a Wish Fulfilled
episodes.description: Ciri gets a chance to prove herself during a robbery. Geralt gains an unlikely ally, as does Yennefer when she visits Montecalvo to look for sanctuary.

episodes.title: Trial by Ordeal
episodes.description: A witch trial pulls Geralt away from his quest. Ciri taps further into the darkness of her new life. Yennefer brings more recruits to her cause.

episodes.title: A Sermon of Survival
episodes.description: Yennefer's conviction starts to waver. Ciri opens up to Mistle about her true identity. Geralt finds himself at the mercy of Dijkstra.

episodes.title: The Joy of Cooking
episodes.description: Catching their breath before attempting a river crossing, Geralt and his party regale each other with stories and song, revealing a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Twilight of the Wolf
episodes.description: Out of options, Yennefer rallies her novices in a deadly battle against the army of Vilgefortz. A dangerous foe catches Ciri's scent.

episodes.title: What I love I do not carry
episodes.description: A trek through treacherous swamplands confronts Geralt with troubling visions. Emhyr discovers what he must do in order to claim absolute power.

episodes.title: Baptism of Fire
episodes.description: As the Continent sinks deeper into war, Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri each meet their fate on the roads they took to avoid it.

movies.title: Money Heist
movies.synopsis: Eight thieves take hostages and lock themselves in the Royal Mint of Spain as a criminal mastermind manipulates the police to carry out his plan.
movies.creator: Álex Pina

episodes.title: The End of the Road
episodes.description: The Professor faces off with Sierra as Tamayo raises the stakes of the negotiations by calling the army. In the past, Berlin meets with a family member.

episodes.title: Do You Believe in Reincarnation?
episodes.description: Arturo seizes an opportunity to fight back while escalating a personal vengeance. Lisbon makes a crucial discovery.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Spectacle of Life
episodes.description: A betrayal and an emergency both catch Sierra by surprise. Palermo rallies the troops as the army closes in on the gang.

episodes.title: Your Place in Heaven
episodes.description: With Helsinki's life in danger, the thieves mount a covert counter attack. Years earlier, Berlin and his son conduct their first heist together.

episodes.title: Live Many Lives
episodes.description: While surrounded by gunfire and trapped in the kitchen, Tokyo reminisces about her first love and her initial encounter with the Professor.

episodes.title: Escape Valve
episodes.description: Sierra takes advantage of the Professor's grief and gains the upper hand. Meanwhile, the team deals with the emotional fallout of their dead friend.

episodes.title: Wishful Thinking
episodes.description: Tamayo mounts a manhunt in his neighborhood as his foes hide. In the past, Berlin and Palermo explain how they plan on getting the gold out of the bank.

episodes.title: The Elegance Theory
episodes.description: Tamayo hunts for the gold as the team races against the clock. Mónica worries she's having a psychotic break. Years earlier, Berlin is deceived.

episodes.title: Pillow Talk
episodes.description: The Professor is left reeling after his tactics are used against him, and when it seems like all hope is lost, he makes a bold decision.

episodes.title: A Family Tradition
episodes.description: With multiple lives on the line and Spain's economy at stake, the Professor and Tamayo engage in one final showdown.

movies.title: Alice in Borderland
movies.synopsis: An aimless gamer and his two friends find themselves in a parallel Tokyo, where they're forced to compete in a series of sadistic games to survive.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Back in the real world with no memories of Borderland, Arisu and Usagi encounter Ryuji, a professor with a fixation on near-death experiences.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: The first game begins at a shrine. Arisu and the other players must solve math problems on the fly before everything goes up in flames.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: As Rei's plan unravels, Arisu takes a risky move to keep his team alive. On a separate stage, Usagi and Ryuji face a relentless barrage of lasers.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: With time running out and a crash imminent, Usagi's group must jump trains to survive. An explosive game of Kick the Can awaits Arisu's team.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Arisu follows his digital double through a simulation of future Shibuya, stopping at a heartwarming scene — and the real Usagi before him.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Haunted by a devastating glimpse into the future, Arisu crumples under the pressure to save everyone. Will he, Usagi and the team make it to the exit?

movies.title: Safe
movies.synopsis: After his teenage daughter goes missing, a widowed surgeon in an affluent neighborhood begins unearthing dark secrets about the people closest to him.
movies.creator: Harlan Coben

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: When his teenage daughter doesn't return home after a party, Tom Delaney anxiously combs the neighborhood and learns her boyfriend is also missing.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Fearing a friend was involved in Jenny's disappearance, Tom enlists Sophie's help. Emma investigates disturbing allegations about a teacher.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: An anonymous tip leads to a frenzied chase -- and another puzzling clue. Zoe draws up a list of grudges. Tom glimpses a side of Rachel he never knew.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: While Tom follows a new lead about Jenny, Sophie and Emma deliver devastating news. The Marshalls struggle to keep their cool.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: In the wake of a dangerous confrontation, Sophie warns Tom to stay out of the investigation. Tom learns that Jenny was hiding a secret.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: As a deadly fire rages, Tom frantically tracks Jenny's phone. More details about Chris's death emerge, and a confession tears a family apart.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Sophie blocks Tom's attempts to speak with Henry. While searching for Bobby at Heaven, Tom and Pete spot a familiar face.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Tom begs for Sophie's help getting to Bobby. Before the night of the party, a cryptic entry in Rachel's diary sends Jenny on a quest for the truth.

movies.title: Crawl
movies.synopsis: While trying to save her dad during a hurricane, a woman becomes trapped in the flooded crawl space of their home as a deadly threat lurks in the water.

movies.title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion (Hindi Version)
movies.synopsis: To avenge his father's death, a young man leads an army into battle against a cruel tyrant in this Hindi conclusion to the historic saga.

movies.title: BAKI
movies.synopsis: While martial arts champion Baki Hanma trains hard to surpass his legendary father, five violent death row inmates descend upon Tokyo to take him on.

episodes.title: Begin! The Centennial Tournament
episodes.description: Mohammad Alai Jr. tests a battle-eager Yujiro. Even though he's been poisoned, Sea King Retsu enters Baki into the Great Raitai Tournament in China.

episodes.title: Turnaround
episodes.description: Alai Jr.'s deadly speed makes quick work of his opponent. A severely emaciated Baki faces Sea King Li, the greatest Poison Hand user in all of China.

episodes.title: Revived!
episodes.description: Sea Emperor Kaku is 121 years older than his opponent, but the legendary reigning champion doesn't hesitate to face Sea King Samwan in the arena.

episodes.title: Team Formed!
episodes.description: Sea King Chin and Japan's sole Sea King, Jaku, battle on the tournament floor. Meanwhile, Baki provokes Yujiro into fighting him offstage.

episodes.title: Hand Pocket
episodes.description: Biscuit Oliva's sheer power is unrivaled, but Shobun Ron and his unconventional fighting stance are unbothered. It's brute strength versus iai kenpo.

episodes.title: Excellennnnt!
episodes.description: A genius of Chinese kenpo, Retsu is the superior fighter, but Jaku's dirty techniques and tactical prowess make him a formidable foe.

episodes.title: Kaioh
episodes.description: Sea Emperor Kaku is the embodiment of Chinese kenpo. Yujiro Hanma is known as the strongest creature on Earth. A battle unlike any other begins!

episodes.title: The Title of the Strongest
episodes.description: Yujiro pits his raw power against Kaku's martial arts skills, which he's honed for over a century. The match's shocking outcome stuns everyone.

episodes.title: The Master vs the Boxer
episodes.description: Alai Jr. proposes to Kozue, who's dumbfounded. To prove he's a better man than Baki, Alai Jr. challenges the elderly aikido master Goki Shibukawa.

episodes.title: Stand and Fight
episodes.description: Alai Jr. continues testing his skill against notable fighters, but Baki's half-brother Jack Hammer is unlike any combatant he's faced before.

movies.title: Rampage
movies.synopsis: When a strange chemical mutates three animals into overgrown, aggressive beasts, a primatologist must find an antidote before they destroy the city.

movies.title: The Ritual
movies.synopsis: Four friends with a long-standing -- but strained -- connection take a hiking trip into the Swedish wilderness, from which they may never return.

movies.title: ONE PIECE
movies.synopsis: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure in this live-action adaptation of the popular manga.

episodes.title: THE BEGINNING AND THE END
episodes.description: To prepare for the Grand Line, the Straw Hats visit Loguetown, birthplace of the Great Pirate Era — where rivals both old and new await.

episodes.title: GOOD WHALE HUNTING
episodes.description: When the Merry lands in the belly of a giant whale, Luffy must win over a gruff lighthouse keeper to save his friends and his ship.

episodes.title: WHISKY BUSINESS
episodes.description: The crew receives a warm welcome to the pirate-loving town of Whisky Peak. But with a pair of assassins on the loose, trouble isn't far behind.

episodes.title: BIG TROUBLE IN LITTLE GARDEN
episodes.description: A new addition to the ship raises the stakes. On the lush isle of Little Garden, the crew encounters an adventure of giant proportions.

episodes.title: WAX ON, WAX OFF
episodes.description: The Straw Hats are held captive by two artists: one who colors emotions, and one intent on making them part of his latest — and deadliest — masterwork.

episodes.title: NAMI DEEREST
episodes.description: When Nami is stricken by a mysterious illness, Luffy and Sanji embark on a perilous mission to save her. Smoker and Tashigi investigate a Marine outpost.

episodes.title: REINDEER SHAMES
episodes.description: Dr. Kureha tells the heartwrenching story of Chopper's origins, including how he met his mentor Dr. Hiriluk and their quest to cure all disease.

episodes.title: DEER AND LOATHING IN DRUM KINGDOM
episodes.description: The Straw Hats lend themselves to Drum Island's cause when King Wapol and his army of monsters return to reclaim the throne.

movies.title: Extraction
movies.synopsis: A hardened mercenary's mission becomes a soul-searching race to survive when he's sent into Bangladesh to rescue a drug lord's kidnapped son.

movies.title: Bridgerton
movies.synopsis: As a new crop of debutantes yearns to become the brightest of the ball, a wallflower with a double life finds her light amid secrets and surprises.
movies.creator: Chris Van Dusen

episodes.title: The Waltz
episodes.description: Despite pressure from the ton, Benedict Bridgerton isn't one to settle down — until a masked woman at a ball unexpectedly captures his heart.

episodes.title: Time Transfixed
episodes.description: To find his mystery woman, Benedict enlists the help of none other than Lady Whistledown. Lady Danbury's patience with the Queen wears decidedly thin.

episodes.title: The Field Next to the Other Road
episodes.description: An unexpected detour draws Benedict and Sophie closer together. Back in Mayfair, the help gains the upper hand in a heated "maid war."

episodes.title: An Offer From a Gentleman
episodes.description: Eager to focus on her new role, Sophie finds her longing for Benedict is hard to shake. Francesca broaches a sensitive topic. Violet hosts tea for two.

episodes.title: Yes or No
episodes.description: A new neighbor shakes up Bridgerton House. Hyacinth and Gregory take their first steps into society. Penelope struggles with the loss of anonymity.

episodes.title: The Passing Winter
episodes.description: Sophie fears the consequences of an impulsive decision. Benedict comes to terms with a new heir. A lavish ball is upended by a shocking announcement.

episodes.title: The Beyond
episodes.description: The Bridgerton family unites in the wake of a tragedy. Sophie's plans hit a snag. Benedict faces a heartwrenching choice.

episodes.title: Dance in the Country
episodes.description: With Sophie in peril and the entire family's reputation at stake, the Bridgertons must rely on the ton's most powerful currency: scandal.

movies.title: The Nun
movies.synopsis: A young nun travels with a priest to Romania to uncover the secrets behind a malevolent spirit haunting a sacred site.

movies.title: The Queen's Gambit
movies.synopsis: In a 1950s orphanage, a young girl reveals an astonishing talent for chess and begins an unlikely journey to stardom while grappling with addiction.
movies.creator: Scott Frank, Allan Scott

episodes.title: Openings
episodes.description: Sent to an orphanage at age 9, Beth develops an uncanny knack for chess — and a growing dependence on the green tranquilizers given to the children.

episodes.title: Exchanges
episodes.description: Suddenly plunged into a confusing new life in suburbia, teenage Beth studies her high school classmates and hatches a plan to enter a chess tournament.

episodes.title: Doubled Pawns
episodes.description: The trip to Cincinnati launches Beth and her mother into a whirlwind of travel and press coverage. Beth sets her sights on the U.S. Open in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Middle Game
episodes.description: Russian class opens the door to a new social scene. In Mexico City, Beth meets the intimidating Borgov, while her mother cozies up to a pen pal.

episodes.title: Fork
episodes.description: Back home in Kentucky, a shaken Beth reconnects with a former opponent who offers to help sharpen her game ahead of the U.S. Championship.

episodes.title: Adjournment
episodes.description: After training with Benny in New York, Beth heads to Paris for her rematch with Borgov. But a wild night sends her into a self-destructive spiral.

episodes.title: End Game
episodes.description: A visit from an old friend forces Beth to reckon with her past and rethink her priorities — just in time for the biggest match of her life.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
movies.synopsis: A mission gone wrong forces Ethan Hunt and his team to work with the CIA, and familiar faces, as they race to save the world from nuclear devastation.

movies.title: Outer Banks
movies.synopsis: On an island of haves and have-nots, teen John B enlists his three best friends to hunt for a legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance.
movies.creator: Josh Pate, Jonas Pate, Shannon Burke

episodes.title: The Crossing
episodes.description: Devastated by a loss and stranded in Morocco, the Pogues navigate a treacherous border crossing as they race to intercept Groff — and the Blue Crown.

episodes.title: The Crown
episodes.description: With her quest for vengeance hanging in the balance, Kiara strikes an uneasy deal with a rival. Groff's scheme to get rich goes sideways in Dubrovnik.

episodes.title: The Square Grouper
episodes.description: The crew hits rock bottom with a hostile homecoming to the OBX, but the tide begins to turn when John B snags a lucrative catch.

episodes.title: Inside Job
episodes.description: With Sarah's life at stake, Rafe runs interference at a Kook golf tournament while John B attempts a brazen heist in the heart of Figure 8.

episodes.title: The Scytale
episodes.description: Kiara and Pope search for a mysterious artifact that could unlock the Blue Crown's powers. Rafe faces mounting pressure to sell Tannyhill to developers.

episodes.title: The Big Easy
episodes.description: Sarah and John B hit the road to pursue a fresh lead in New Orleans, where Sarah comes face-to-face with a figure from her past.

episodes.title: Bal des Sauvages
episodes.description: The Pogues infiltrate a glitzy masquerade party, where Kiara angles for access to the scytale drawings — and crosses paths with a murderous enemy.

episodes.title: The Runway Part 2
episodes.description: The friends get crafty to decode the scytale's secrets. Rafe becomes a wanted man when a violent mistake catches up to him. Cleo makes an explosive move.

episodes.title: Arise, Arise
episodes.description: A mission to Azerbaijan gets rocky when Pope engineers a daring ambush. Kiara rushes to outpace the Corsairs and test the Crown's powers of resurrection.

episodes.title: The Storm and What Came After
episodes.description: As a raging hurricane lashes Kildare, the Pogues race to save their loved ones and settle the score before a life-changing treasure slips away — again.

movies.title: Avatar The Last Airbender
movies.synopsis: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save a world at war — and fight a ruthless enemy bent on stopping him.

episodes.title: Somewhere Safe
episodes.description: Determined to learn earthbending, Aang works to free Bumi from prison. Zuko chafes at Iroh's plan to stay hidden. Azula receives a new assignment.

episodes.title: A Fight, Once Begun
episodes.description: At a high-stakes earthbending match, Aang discovers the teacher he's been seeking. Painful memories emerge after Zuko befriends a farming family.

episodes.title: City of Walls and Secrets
episodes.description: Aang and his friends must trade powers for parties and politics as they navigate the two-faced court of the Earth King.

episodes.title: The Water Falls, the Stones Emerge
episodes.description: Toph puts Aang's skills to the test. In the streets of Ba Sing Se, Sokka searches for a missing friend, while Katara lives a double life.

episodes.title: Ten Thousand Things
episodes.description: To uncover a mythic library that could hold the key to defeating the Fire Nation, the team is forced to ally with an old enemy.

episodes.title: The Parable of the Two Dragons
episodes.description: When one of their own is captured, the team concocts a risky plan to reach the Earth King. An illness changes Zuko's perspective — and Iroh's.

episodes.title: Something Broken
episodes.description: Torn across the city as the Fire Nation closes in, the team must reunite to save Ba Sing Se — and Zuko must decide where his real loyalties lie.

movies.title: Crazy Rich Asians
movies.synopsis: When she joins her boyfriend on a trip to his native Singapore, Rachel Chu discovers his family's luxurious wealth and faces his disapproving mother.

movies.title: Virgin River
movies.synopsis: Searching for a fresh start, a nurse practitioner moves from LA to a remote northern California town and is surprised by what — and who — she finds.
movies.creator: Sue Tenney

episodes.title: The Afterglow
episodes.description: Mel and Jack weigh Marley's offer — and debate honeymoon destinations — as they begin married life together. Brie and Mike confront their issues.

episodes.title: Beautiful Child
episodes.description: Marley assesses Jack's fatherhood potential. Doc struggles to hold back when a patient seeks help. Brady searches for Lark — and his money.

episodes.title: The Match
episodes.description: Mel, Jack and Marley examine more than the wares at a local flea market. Hope's campaign against Grace Valley hits a snag at a town hall meeting.

episodes.title: Pipe Dreams
episodes.description: Jack and Mel prepare their unfinished home for a visit from a social worker. Brie does Brady a friendly favor. Doc takes a swing at something new.

episodes.title: Always Anywhere Forever
episodes.description: Mel makes an unexpectedly dangerous house call. The sewing circle shares their concerns with Kaia. Hope and Doc get high on memories of young love.

episodes.title: No Regrets
episodes.description: An abrupt arrival threatens to upend Mel and Jack's plans. Kaia and Brady team up to tackle a wildfire. Preacher makes an ambitious proposal.

episodes.title: It Takes A Village
episodes.description: Doc faces off with Dr. Hayes at a pivotal medical board hearing. A baby shower pushes Lizzie to her breaking point. Clay opens up about his past.

episodes.title: Back In The Saddle
episodes.description: Clay tries to buck his troubles by entering a high-stakes rodeo competition. Brie tracks an unlikely new lead in the search for Charmaine.

episodes.title: La Luna De Miel
episodes.description: Eager to escape their worries, Mel and Jack embark on their honeymoon, where a freewheeling day trip takes a surprising turn.

episodes.title: David and Goliath
episodes.description: The town gathers for a festive Founder's Day, where Hope stages a last-ditch effort to preserve Virgin River. Mel and Jack receive life-changing news.

movies.title: Locke & Key
movies.synopsis: After their dad's murder, three siblings move with their mom to his ancestral estate, where they discover magical keys that unlock powers — and secrets.

episodes.title: The Snow Globe
episodes.description: A mysterious snow globe unleashes a double dose of trouble at Keyhouse, leaving Bode out in the cold as Kinsey and Nina try to retrieve a stolen key.

episodes.title: Wedding Crashers
episodes.description: Duncan's wedding day brings a welcome surprise — and provides the perfect opportunity for uninvited guests to search the house. Bode discovers a new key.

episodes.title: Five Minutes Past
episodes.description: Bode looks for the key that will let him see his dad, Nina confronts bad memories, and Kinsey gathers with the Savinis for an emotional send-off.

episodes.title: Deep Cover
episodes.description: Bode's sudden attitude change worries his family and friends, Tyler catches up with a co-worker, and Gideon forms an unholy alliance.

episodes.title: Siege
episodes.description: Suspicions about Bode's behavior come to a head after an unsettling discovery, while Gideon's patience runs out in his plot to possess the keys.

episodes.title: Free Bird
episodes.description: Gideon's henchman grabs leverage to use against the Lockes as Tyler and Kinsey look for a way to help Bode, who's devising a clever plan of his own.

episodes.title: Curtain
episodes.description: Gideon forces Ellie to take him to the missing key, putting an old classmate's life on the line. Nina and Bode attempt to unlock the Harlequin Chest.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.description: With Gideon hell-bent on acquiring the Creation Key, the Lockes race to stop him, leading to a vicious clash — and a decision that changes everything.

movies.title: Lupin
movies.synopsis: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.
movies.creator: George Kay

episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.description: To mend matters with Claire and Raoul, Assane devises a plan to get them out of France. But with high stakes come greater risks — and no room for error.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.description: An unfathomable loss rocks France, but Guédira and Raoul grapple with denial. A mysterious classified ad resurrects old ghosts and long-lost hopes.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.description: As Fleur and Guédira strike a deal, Belkacem visits Benjamin. Assane tries to outmaneuver a new enemy in the shadows while keeping tabs on his family.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.description: Assane meets his mother's captor in the flesh, but there's no sign of her. Tasked with another all-or-nothing heist, he makes a devastating choice.

episodes.title: Chapter 5
