episodes.description: Increasingly suspicious, Claire launches an investigation of her own. Guédira gets the surprise — and opportunity — of a literature lover's lifetime.

episodes.title: Chapter 6
episodes.description: Having identified his opponent, Assane races to protect his family and avoid retaliation. Belkacem remains wary of Guédira; Mariama sends a message.

episodes.title: Chapter 7
episodes.description: A family reunion years in the making comes to pass. With Mariama's help, Assane makes a final play to stop Keller, right his wrongs and go out in style.

movies.title: Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting!
movies.synopsis: Rescued from bullies by professional boxer Mamoru Takamura, young Ippo Makunouchi takes up boxing to pursue what it means to be strong.

episodes.title: The Strongest Challenger
episodes.description: Recalling a childhood promise to become stronger, Ippo trains for a battle against an opponent who has vowed to overcome Ippo's Dempsey Roll attack.

episodes.title: The Dempsey Roll Destroyed
episodes.description: As the intense match draws to a close, Ippo struggles to catch his breath, making Shimabukuro all the more determined to defeat the Dempsey Roll.

episodes.title: A Woman’s Battle
episodes.description: Itagaki’s sister visits Ippo as he recovers from his injuries at home. Meanwhile, Aoki works to get back in shape before his first title match.

episodes.title: The Goddess of Victory
episodes.description: Aoki gets upset when his opponent, Imae, mocks his signature move prior to the title match. Later, Ippo sees Imae arguing with an ex-girlfriend.

episodes.title: 100% Fake
episodes.description: As the title match finally begins, Imae deftly dodges Aoki’s Frog Punch. Just when Imae's victory seems certain, Aoki begins moving unpredictably.

episodes.title: The Distance Between me and Glory
episodes.description: Although weakened and shocked by Aoki’s new tactic, Imae resolutely stays on the offensive. Aoki makes a final desperate attempt to win the belt.

episodes.title: Cheese Champion
episodes.description: In Osaka for Sendo’s match, Ippo meets a boxer nicknamed the Owari Dragon. The next day, a letter offering a challenge arrives at the Kamogawa gym.

episodes.title: The Mad Dog and The Red Wolf
episodes.description: Takamura warns Ippo that the Dempsey Roll won't be enough to beat Sawamura. Ippo devotes himself to developing an improved version of the move.

episodes.title: A Savage Scenario
episodes.description: Volg visits Japan to get his boxing gloves back from Ippo. Unable to improve the Dempsey Roll themselves, Kimura and the others ask Volg for help.

episodes.title: The Face of Determination
episodes.description: As the match against Sawamura approaches, Ippo focuses intensely on refining his signature skill — but his efforts begin to take a physical toll.

movies.title: Love Is Blind
movies.synopsis: Nick and Vanessa Lachey host this social experiment where single men and women look for love and get engaged, all before meeting in person.

episodes.title: Enchanted To Meet You
episodes.description: Eager to strike a swift love match, hopeful singles get the romance rolling by bonding over astrology, dad jokes and their tastes in music.

episodes.title: What a Woman!
episodes.description: Flying sparks or mixed signals? From health diagnoses to having kids, the conversations turn serious as participants try to uncover real chemistry.

episodes.title: Together at Last
episodes.description: As one pair leaps into a proposal, messy love triangles, shallow comments and fumbled chances haunt singles still searching for a partner.

episodes.title: Sink Or Swim
episodes.description: Two more couples prepare for a magic moment beyond the pods. Will the bond they've built behind closed doors sizzle or fizzle once they're face to face?

episodes.title: Here Comes the Dud
episodes.description: After finally seeing one another in person, the newly engaged couples fly to a luxurious resort in Mexico to test their physical chemistry in paradise.

movies.title: Cobra Kai
movies.synopsis: Bitter enemies. Warring dojos. New blood. Daniel and Johnny reignite old West Valley rivalries in this follow-up series to the "Karate Kid" films.
movies.creator: Josh Heald, Jon Hurwitz, Hayden Schlossberg

episodes.title: Peacetime in the Valley
episodes.description: The Miyagi-Do students struggle to put aside past rivalries while training for the Sekai Taikai. Johnny and Chozen clash over rebranding the dojo.

episodes.title: The Prize
episodes.description: Kreese faces a dangerous test to prove his worthiness. Daniel offers Johnny a helping hand while the teens contemplate life beyond high school.

episodes.title: Sleeper
episodes.description: A shocking discovery turns Daniel's world upside down. Johnny schemes a way to give Sam and Tory their edge back. The tournament reveals its location.

episodes.title: Underdogs
episodes.description: Daniel and Johnny invite a new sensei to evaluate their students. Friends become foes as the competition heats up for a spot in the Sekai Taikai.

episodes.title: Best of the Best
episodes.description: Miyagi-Do's top students square off to be team captains, but a devastating tragedy changes everything. Kreese reveals his final surprise.

episodes.title: Benvinguts a Barcelona
episodes.description: With the Sekai Taikai underway, a betrayal threatens to throw team Miyagi-Do off their game. A dramatic first event unleashes the element of surprise.

episodes.title: Dog in the Fight
episodes.description: The search for clues about Mr. Miyagi's past leads Daniel into danger. Miguel raises doubts about Robby's focus. Sam observes ugly behavior off the mat.

episodes.title: Snakes on a Plane
episodes.description: A personal crisis shakes Miguel and Johnny to the core. Chozen and a rival sensei team up to find their students — but discover something else instead.

episodes.title: Blood In Blood Out
episodes.description: Who will move to the next round in the tournament's tag team elimination match: Miyagi-Do or Cobra Kai? A shocking revelation shatters Daniel's world.

episodes.title: Eunjangdo
episodes.description: Daniel and Johnny use historic Barcelona as a training ground for their captains. But a cheap shot in the semifinals sparks a brawl to end all brawls.

movies.title: Ginny & Georgia
movies.synopsis: Free-spirited Georgia and her two kids, Ginny and Austin, move north in search of a fresh start but find that the road to new beginnings can be bumpy.
movies.creator: Sarah Lampert

episodes.title: This Wouldn’t Even Be a Podcast
episodes.description: With all of Wellsbury abuzz about her arrest, Georgia's history of lies threatens to unravel. Facing personal struggles, Ginny and Marcus reconnect.

episodes.title: Beep Beep Freaking Beep
episodes.description: Georgia and her attorney spar over defense strategy. As Ginny finds a creative way to channel her feelings, Zion weighs what's best for his daughter.

episodes.title: Friends Can Dance
episodes.description: Old sparks — and heartaches — reignite at the school's spring dance. Austin faces rejection in the classroom, while Paul weathers turmoil at the office.

episodes.title: The Bitch Is Back
episodes.description: As jury selection begins, Georgia puts her keen observational skills to good use. An impulsive decision jeopardizes Marcus' future.

episodes.title: Boom Goes The Dynamite
episodes.description: An explosive testimony transforms the trial. To distract herself from her home life, Ginny connects with an intriguing outsider.

episodes.title: At Least It Can’t Get Any Worse
episodes.description: Cut off from support, Georgia hits an emotional rock bottom. Paul's political challenges mount. To ease the tension, Max summons her BFFs.

episodes.title: That’s Wild
episodes.description: Desperate to speak with her mom, Ginny relies on Max and Sophie to clear the way. Gil tries to win Austin's trust.

episodes.title: Is That A Packed Lunch
episodes.description: As the prosecution rests, a dramatic shift in the case raises the stakes for Georgia. Ginny opens up to her dad and opens doors with her writing.

episodes.title: It’s Time For My Solo
episodes.description: Georgia welcomes an unlikely advocate in the courtroom. As the curtain rises on the school musical, emotions run high and painful secrets emerge.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.description: With Georgia's freedom on the line, the trial reaches a dramatic conclusion. Ginny takes a page from her mom's playbook.

movies.title: The Curse of La Llorona
movies.synopsis: In 1970s Los Angeles, a troubled single mother discovers some folktales are true when a dark entity with sinister intentions pursues her children.

movies.title: Emily in Paris
movies.synopsis: An American sets out to conquer Paris with her charm, style and très bad French in this global hit the Daily Beast calls "the best show on television."
movies.creator: Darren Star

episodes.title: La Dolce Emily
episodes.description: Emily muddies her haute heels to sniff out a fresh opportunity, while Sylvie charms Rome's elite with help from a cash-strapped princess.

episodes.title: Got to be Real
episodes.description: A fashion faux pas makes Emily question what's authentic and what's not. Mindy gets shaken up when she's enlisted to garnish a colossal cocktail.

episodes.title: Intimissimi Issues
episodes.description: Sylvie and Giancarlo's on-set squabbles drive their production off-script. A revealing lingerie campaign inspires Emily to bare something deeper.

episodes.title: Rome Has Fallen
episodes.description: Sylvie braces for premiere-day criticism in Solitano. Mindy dodges a tough conversation. Emily discovers that viral success isn't all roses.

episodes.title: Bonjour Paris!
episodes.description: Newly returned to Paris, Emily must intervene when a culinary cancellation imperils a hotel opening. Sylvie unexpectedly becomes a plus-one at home.

episodes.title: The One Where Emily Goes to the Embassy
episodes.description: Nostalgic for a taste of home, Emily indulges her sweet tooth on American soil. A crash course in social media sends Sylvie spying on a frenemy's feed.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.description: A mic-drop moment turns heads at a fashion industry conference. After a flood of bad PR, a luxury water brand turns to Agence Grateau to stay afloat.

episodes.title: Fashion Statement
episodes.description: Emily charms a designer's dog to score a meeting. Across town, Sylvie stumbles into scandal at a fête full of family drama.

episodes.title: La Belle Époque
episodes.description: Marcello's dreams hang by a thread when he lands a coveted showcase with a two-week turnaround. A surprise visitor reminds Emily of a bygone era.

episodes.title: Veni, Vidi, Venezia
episodes.description: In the sink-or-swim chaos of Venice Fashion Week, Emily scrambles to hit a high-water mark. Back in Paris, the agency faces a tidal wave of its own.

movies.title: Squid Game
movies.synopsis: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.
movies.creator: Hwang Dong-hyuk

episodes.title: Keys and Knives
episodes.description: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

episodes.title: The Starry Night
episodes.description: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

episodes.title: It's Not Your Fault
episodes.description: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.
Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.
No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

episodes.title: Humans Are…
episodes.description: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

movies.title: Delhi Crime
movies.synopsis: Following the police force as they investigate high-profile crimes in Delhi, this series has seasons inspired by both real and fictional events.
movies.creator: Richie Mehta

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: After her transfer to Assam, Vartika unearths a network smuggling young women to Delhi under the guise of jobs. Neeti probes an injured baby's case.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Vartika's investigation uncovers deeper connections as Khushi reveals startling truths about Baby Noor. Kalyani's court hearing takes a shocking turn.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description:
Rahul's confessions about working with Kalyani help the team draw links to the bride trade.
Neeti and Simran edge closer to the missing mother's location.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: The hunt for Shabnam intensifies, revealing fresh leads. Kusum gets bail and meets Meena. A deeper probe into the Santro car lands Simran in trouble.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: As Vartika's meeting with Mithul Khanna goes awry, Shabnam has a tearful reunion with her children. Neeti searches for her missing colleague.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Shaken by tragic news, the team races to find the missing women as Vartika's career hangs in the balance. Will they catch Meena before all hope is lost?

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
movies.synopsis: After a demon attack leaves his family slain and his sister cursed, Tanjiro embarks upon a perilous journey to find a cure and avenge those he's lost.

episodes.title: To Defeat Muzan Kibutsuji
episodes.description: The Hashira hold a meeting at Ubuyashiki Mansion while Tanjiro recovers. Later, they devise a training plan for the entire Demon Slayer Corps.

episodes.title: Water Hashira Giyu Tomioka's Pain
episodes.description: Tanjiro visits Giyu and persistently asks him to train him. Reaching the limits of his patience, Giyu reveals why he refuses to train Tanjiro.

episodes.title: Fully Recovered Tanjiro Joins the Hashira Training!!
episodes.description: A recuperated Tanjiro heads to his first training course. After a joyful reunion with former Hashira Uzui, he joins in some strenuous exercises.

episodes.title: To Bring a Smile to One's Face
episodes.description: After arriving at Muichiro's residence, Tanjiro learns that his fellow swordsmen are disheartened by Muichiro's tough training and harsh words.

episodes.title: I Even Ate Demons
episodes.description: After doing some flexibility exercises with Mitsuri, Tanjiro goes to train with an angry Iguro, who aims to improve Tanjiro's precision with a sword.

episodes.title: The Strongest of the Demon Slayer Corps
episodes.description: Zenitsu and Tanjiro reunite with Inosuke and Murata at Himejima's training grounds, where they must face brutal tests of endurance and strength.

episodes.title: Stone Hashira Gyomei Himejima
episodes.description: Tanjiro collapses in exhaustion after moving the boulder. Impressed by Tanjiro's attitude, Himejima opens up about how he raised orphans in a temple.

episodes.title: The Hashira Unite
episodes.description: Kagaya finally comes face to face with Muzan Kibutsuji. Alerted to an attack, the Hashira and Tanjiro hurry toward the Ubuyashiki residence.

movies.title: Extraction 2
movies.synopsis: Back from the brink of death, highly skilled commando Tyler Rake takes on another dangerous mission: saving the imprisoned family of a ruthless gangster.

movies.title: Toolsidas Junior
movies.synopsis: A young boy seeks to master the game of snooker to defend his father’s legacy after a humiliating loss. But first, he’ll need help from a hardened pro.
Amid doubt and derision, indomitable captain Kapil Dev leads India's struggling cricket team to make history at the 1983 World Cup. Based on true events.

movies.title: Dog Gone
movies.synopsis: When his beloved dog goes missing, a young man embarks on an incredible search with his parents to find him and give him life-saving medication.

movies.title: Red Notice
movies.synopsis: An FBI profiler pursuing the world's most wanted art thief becomes his reluctant partner in crime to catch an elusive crook who's always one step ahead.

movies.title: Ranma1/2
movies.synopsis: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

episodes.title: Ranma's Weakness
episodes.description: Another of Akane's suitors, the quiet Gosunkugi, begins stalking Ranma to find the martial artist's weakness. Will he unearth Ranma's secret?

episodes.title: Attack of the Wild Mousse
episodes.description: Ranma's problems continue as he deals with the aftermath of his trance, Shampoo's new secret, her meddlesome great-grandmother and a jealous rival.

episodes.title: Chestnuts Roasting on  an Open Fire
episodes.description: After a heated battle with Mousse, Ranma remains stuck in his female form and must master a difficult technique to obtain the antidote for his condition.

episodes.title: Naval Engagement
episodes.description: Ranma follows the Cat Café to the beach, where a Martial Arts Watermelon Splitting Race stands in his way of finally retrieving the real Phoenix Pill.

episodes.title: It's Fast or It's Free
episodes.description: Cologne learns about the annual Martial Arts Delivery Race and signs Shampoo up to compete against Akane and Ranma. Who will reach the final goal first?

episodes.title: The Evil Wakes
episodes.description: When the lecherous Happosai escapes to Nerima, seeking the disciples who imprisoned him, Akane and Ranma team up to deal with his perverted antics.

episodes.title: Instant Spring
episodes.description: Shampoo receives a mysterious package. Meanwhile, Soun and Genma's plan to bring Ranma and Akane closer backfires when the real dojo destroyer shows up.

episodes.title: Okonomiyaki" Means "I Love You
episodes.description: Ranma finds himself in a bind when he learns that the new transfer student is the person who attacked his father — and his long-lost childhood friend!

episodes.title: Love Letters in the Sauce
episodes.description: In order to be with Ranma, Ukyo hatches a scheme to help Ryoga get a date with Akane. Unfortunately, things don't go according to plan...

episodes.title: Not Your Typical Juliet
episodes.description: After years cast in boyish roles, Akane finally gets to play her dream role: Juliet! But will the prospective Romeos' antics ruin her precious chance?

movies.title: Murder Mystery 2
movies.synopsis: After starting their own detective agency, Nick and Audrey Spitz land a career-making case when their billionaire pal is kidnapped from his wedding.

movies.title: Wednesday
movies.synopsis: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates a murder spree while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.
movies.creator: Alfred Gough, Miles Millar

episodes.title: Here We Woe Again
episodes.description: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

episodes.title: The Devil You Woe
episodes.description: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

episodes.title: Call of the Woe
episodes.description: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

episodes.title: If These Woes Could Talk
episodes.description: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

episodes.title: Hyde and Woe Seek
episodes.description: With Tyler on the loose, Wednesday readies for a risky Día de los Muertos showdown. Slurp's growing hunger poses problems for Pugsley.

episodes.title: Woe Thyself
episodes.description: An encounter with a spirit from Nevermore's past gives Wednesday and Enid a new perspective on one another — and puts one of their classmates in danger.

episodes.title: Woe Me the Money
episodes.description: As the school gala looms, Wednesday digs up dirt on Dort, Enid tries not to wolf out and Morticia engages in a battle of wills with Grandmama.

episodes.title: This Means Woe
episodes.description: When buried family secrets are unearthed, Wednesday must race against time to prevent a dark prophecy from being realized.

movies.title: All of Us Are Dead
movies.synopsis: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.
movies.creator: Lee JQ, Chun Sung-il, Kim Nam-su

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: A disturbance at the camp shifts the military's understanding of the virus. A thunderstorm provides cover as the group agrees to keep on moving.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

movies.title: Brothers
movies.synopsis: After a troubled past with their alcoholic father, two estranged brothers prepare to face each other again as rivals in a street fighting tournament.

movies.title: The King: Eternal Monarch
movies.synopsis: A modern-day Korean emperor passes through a mysterious portal and into a parallel world, where he encounters a feisty police detective.
movies.creator: Kim Eun-sook, Baek Sang-hoon, Jung Jee-hyun

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Lee Gon mourns the tragic death of his father. Lee Lim goes on the run — and finds escape when he comes across a door to a parallel universe.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Gon insists he is an emperor from another world. An incredulous Jeong Tae-eul takes him to the police station, where he sees a familiar face.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Though Tae-eul finds Gon's story difficult to believe, some things about him are completely inexplicable. At work, she gets busy with a murder case.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: When Tae-eul loses her police badge, she can't help but think about Gon. Meanwhile, Kang Sin-jae has had it with his mother's bad habits.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Being introduced to Gon's world is a lot to process for Tae-eul, who's taken to the palace. A disgruntled Jo Yeong keeps an eye on her.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: A potential military conflict threatens the kingdom. Gon promises Tae-eul he will return to her, and steps forward to take care of the situation.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Gon brings Yeong along on his trip back to Tae-eul. He has a favor to ask of her, while she's found something troubling to share with him.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: In Corea, Luna is set free. In Korea, Gon and Yeong run into a man who recognizes them, and Sin-jae experiences childhood flashbacks.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Gon draws closer to tracking down Lim, and asks Jo Eun-sup to trade places with Yeong. Mail from an unknown sender bothers Koo Seo-ryeong.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: On Lunar New Year, Gon and Lim come face-to-face in a public standoff. Tae-eul opens up to Sin-jae about the other world and her ongoing case.

movies.title: IC 814: The Kandahar Hijack
movies.synopsis: When IC 814 gets hijacked on its way to Delhi, hundreds of lives are at stake as the country faces its longest and most alarming aviation crisis.
movies.creator: Anubhav Sinha, Trishant Shrivastava

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: On 24th December 1999, flight IC 814 gets hijacked in Kathmandu. Mukul Mohan identifies the voice of one of the hijackers. DRS learns of a key asset.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: The officials work on procuring the passenger list of IC 814. Meanwhile, the hijackers face obstacles while trying to land the plane.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Captain Sharan Dev prepares to navigate a perilous situation. Ram Chandra Yadav warns of a suspicious object on the plane.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: The plane lands in Kandahar. Aspersions are cast on Captain Sharan, even as he tries to come up with a rescue plan. The negotiating team gets finalized.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: The hijackers lay out their demands but face a tough negotiator in the form of Mohan. The passengers get increasingly uncomfortable.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: A week into the hijack, the Crisis Management Group begins to see discord. Will the negotiators succeed — or will the talks reach a stalemate?

movies.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
movies.synopsis: With his days numbered, high schooler Yuji decides to hunt down and consume the remaining 19 fingers of a deadly curse so it can die with him.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.description: While Yuji and Choso hunt demons in Tokyo, they encounter a vengeful member of the Zenin family — and Yuji’s appointed executioner: Yuta Okkotsu.

episodes.title: One More Time
episodes.description: Struggling to withstand Naoya's rapid attacks, Choso fights back using a Blood Manipulation technique. Okkotsu appears, dragging Yuji behind him.

episodes.title: About the Culling Game
episodes.description: Spurred by Fushiguro, Yuji regroups with Tsukumo and the others hiding out at Jujutsu High. They decide to seek Tengen's advice on what to do next.

episodes.title: Perfect Preparation
episodes.description: Maki visits the Zenin home to get cursed tools for the Culling Game. Ignoring her mother's warning, she opens the warehouse and sees a shocking sight.

episodes.title: Fever
episodes.description: Sentenced to death, Yaga encounters an assassin — and Gakuganji. Yuji and Fushiguro head to an underground fight club to recruit Kinji Hakari.

episodes.title: Cog
episodes.description: After Kirara realizes that Fushiguro is also from Jujutsu High, Fushiguro tries to convince Kirara that the school needs Hakari's help.

episodes.title: Tokyo No.1 Colony Part 1
episodes.description: A Kogane appears to facilitate the culling game and announce additional rules. Yuji's group enters a colony to find a player with over 100 points.

episodes.title: Tokyo No.1 Colony Part 2
episodes.description: Public defender Hiromi Higuruma represents Keita Oe in court against murder and robbery charges. Yuji and Fushiguro have been unexpectedly separated.

episodes.title: Tokyo No.1 Colony Part 3
episodes.description: Feeling potential in the Culling Game, Higuruma rejects Yuji's offer, then expands his domain to summon a Shikigami and start Yuji's trial.

episodes.title: Tokyo No.1 Colony Part 4
episodes.description: After being deceived by Remi and brought before Reggie and the others, Fushiguro is forced into a difficult fight against three opponents.

movies.title: Skater Girl
movies.synopsis: When a teen in rural India discovers a life-changing passion for skateboarding, she faces a rough road as she follows her dream to compete.

movies.title: The Diplomat
movies.synopsis: Amid an international crisis, a career diplomat juggles her new high-profile job as ambassador to the UK and her turbulent marriage to a political star.
movies.creator: Debora Cahn

episodes.title: Windsor
episodes.description: On an unplanned stopover at Windsor Castle, Kate grows wary of Hal and Grace's dynamic as she tries to contain the fallout from their covert actions.

episodes.title: Redcoats
episodes.description: A shocking security breach sends the administration into crisis as Hal assumes new duties. Trowbridge launches a manhunt, and Kate looks to the future.

episodes.title: The Typo
episodes.description: A budgetary snag threatens to torpedo negotiations, with costly implications for the US. Stuart and Eidra get personal as they weigh their next move.

episodes.title: Pagliacci
episodes.description: After Hal drops a bombshell that throws the UK alliance into jeopardy, Kate faces mounting pressure to control the damage by any means necessary.

episodes.title: Special Envoy
episodes.description: Kate contends with her complicity in a stunning political shake-up, while a disenchanted Todd explores his options across the pond.

episodes.title: The Dead
episodes.description: When a dangerous adversary makes its move, Grace issues a hard-line threat to the prime minister, forcing Kate to reckon with her role as the messenger.

episodes.title: Phony Negroni
episodes.description: Personal and political lives collide — and damaging secrets surface — when Kate and Hal join Grace and Todd in Italy ahead of the G7 summit.

episodes.title: Warships
episodes.description: At a meeting of world leaders, a diplomatic breakdown edges the US closer to an international crisis — and compels Kate to make a seismic decision.

movies.title: Khakee: The Bihar Chapter
movies.synopsis: As a righteous cop pursues a merciless criminal in Bihar, he finds himself navigating a deadly chase and a moral battle mired in corruption.
genres: TV Shows Based on Real Life
movies.creator: Neeraj Pandey

episodes.title: PATRA PARICHAY !
episodes.description: Upon arriving in Bihar, police officer Amit Lodha grapples with a tough new way of life — but when a child is kidnapped, he springs into action.

episodes.title: CHANDANWA KA JANM !
episodes.description: Chandan Mahto’s notoriety grows after a bold move. As Amit's career advances, deep-rooted social mindsets and political pressures create hurdles.

episodes.title: AMIT KAUN ???
episodes.description: In the lead-up to state elections, violence breaks out. Amit stands up to political power but receives backlash. Chandan makes a new adversary.

episodes.title: MOOH DIKHAI !!!
episodes.description: After a bloody massacre orchestrated by Chandan, Amit is tasked with capturing the criminal — and faces a vexing road ahead.

episodes.title: MEETA JI KI LOVE STORY !!!
episodes.description: Chandan’s elusive whereabouts spark a new plan, with Amit and Ranjan using phone calls to track him. A secret tryst offers crucial clues.

episodes.title: MEETA JI KI LOVE STORY PART 2
episodes.description: Amit makes a major announcement at a press meet. Chandan sets a trap with deadly consequences, while an explosive revelation stuns the team.

episodes.title: PHACE TO PHACE !
episodes.description: The chase approaches a dramatic end, but peril lurks at every corner. The question remains: can Amit close the case, or will Chandan slip away?

movies.title: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
movies.synopsis: Murder and mystery meet the glittering jazz age in this propulsive period drama, as a plucky young aristocrat investigates the death of the man she loved.
movies.creator: Chris Chibnall

episodes.title: Bundle of Love
episodes.description: A lavish party at the Caterham estate results in sore heads the next day — and one guest not waking up at all. Grief pushes Bundle to search for answers.

episodes.title: Battle Commences
episodes.description: Bundle's desperate search for the killer takes her from London's seedy underbelly to a country house gathering which could change the course of history.

episodes.title: The Finger Points
episodes.description: After the police catch an intruder and Battle finds two bullets, Bundle makes a shocking discovery. Can she finally uncover the mastermind behind it all?

movies.title: Shabaash Mithu
movies.synopsis: From child prodigy to trailblazing captain, sports icon Mithali Raj navigates the highs and lows of professional cricket in this coming-of-age drama.

movies.title: Jaadugar
movies.synopsis: A small-town magician with zero interest in football must lead his local team to the finals of a tournament if he wishes to marry the love of his life.

movies.title: Jersey
movies.synopsis: Ten years after quitting cricket, a gifted but dejected ex-batsman pursues a spot on the national team, hoping to fulfill his son's wish for a jersey.

movies.title: Vincenzo
movies.synopsis: During a visit to his motherland, a Korean-Italian mafia lawyer gives an unrivaled conglomerate a taste of its own medicine with a side of justice.
movies.creator: Kim Hee-won, Park Jae-beom

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Vincenzo Cassano's homecoming is met by distrusting tenants and eager fraudsters. Hong Yu-chan relinquishes his parental rights to Hong Cha-young.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Warned about a scheduled demolition of Geumga Plaza, Vincenzo contrives to thwart the attack. Yu-chan receives a call from a whistleblower.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Vincenzo warns an impassioned Yu-chan about the dangers of a new drug and its even more harmful pharmaceutical company. Choi Myung-hee shows her claws.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Fighting fire with fire, Yu-chan's supporters unite their efforts to carry out his vision of justice. Vincenzo employs Myung-hee's tactics against her.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Jang Joon-woo reminds Jang Han-seo who's the boss. The tenants rally around Vincenzo and Cha-young, who team up to take down Babel Group.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Both sides use every trick in the book to cause disturbances in and out of the courtroom. Han Seung-hyuk and Myung-hee are introduced to Babel's CEO.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Stumped by surprise witnesses, Joon-woo and Myung-hee direct their rage toward Cha-young. The tenants gain new appreciation for their building.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Angered by another conglomerate and its generations of unpunished crimes, Vincenzo tries to charm a young bank president out of investing in Babel.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Joon-woo wields his power to force loyalty from his partners. Cha-young finds refuge in Vincenzo's apartment following a break-in.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Seeking revenge instead of liability for the loss of more innocent victims, Vincenzo puts his life on the line to lure Babel's CEO out of hiding.

movies.title: Stranger Things: Tales From '85
movies.synopsis: In this new story set in the world of "Stranger Things," the original characters encounter fresh mysteries — and a dark series of strange new threats.

episodes.title: Chapter One: A Haunting in Hawkins
episodes.description: Just when it seems like the Hawkins Investigators Club is completely out of cases, a series of strange new events pulls them into a paranormal mystery.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Mine
episodes.description: After hearing Charlie's ghost story, the guys start filming their video history report in the woods. The girls go into business for Valentine's Day.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Curse of Bloodaxe Bill
episodes.description: Glowing flowers, Hate Sprites and a skeleton inside a spooky mine. Are ghosts real, or is the Upside Down at it again? Time for the H.I.C. to investigate.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Séance
episodes.description: The gang plans a séance to summon the ghost of Bloodaxe Bill. But they'll need Nancy's Ouija board — and step-by-step instructions.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Split the Party
episodes.description: Danger scatters the party into smaller groups running for their lives. Mike comes up with a theory to explain what's powering the flowers' eerie glow.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Lich
episodes.description: Our heroes have never seen a creature like this before — and now they're headed straight for its lair. Can El find the Lich before it's too late?

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Golem
episodes.description: A troubling vision reveals the truth about the Lich and where it came from, but it's nearly impossible to believe.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: Count to Five
episodes.description: As the Golem tightens its fear grip on Hawkins, it's up to El and her friends to defend their town — and save the people they love.

movies.title: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
movies.synopsis: In this compelling crime drama from Neeraj Pandey ("Khakee"), a team of honest customs officers at Mumbai airport investigate a global smuggling ring.
movies.creator: Neeraj Pandey

episodes.title: Customs vs Popat
episodes.description: Amid mounting pressure to curb smuggling at Mumbai airport, officer Prakash Kumar takes charge and ends Arjun Meena's suspension so he can lead the team.

episodes.title: Bada Choudhary
episodes.description: Arjun forms his A-Team with formerly suspended officers Mitali and Ravinder, as Prakash tasks them with taking down the Bada Choudhary syndicate.

episodes.title: The Priya Story
episodes.description: Caught smuggling gold by Arjun, flight attendant Priya goes undercover for him. The World Customs Conference offers a chance to trap the smugglers.

episodes.title: Operation Longshot
episodes.description: The customs team mounts a large-scale sting to intercept gold smugglers converging on Mumbai. Bada Choudhary senses something is wrong.

episodes.title: Hum Coin Hain
episodes.description: Prakash is sent to Bangkok, where he meets an unexpected visitor. The search of a suspect's home leads the officers to a troubling incident.

episodes.title: Darr Ka Dhandha
episodes.description: The Choudhary syndicate strikes back with violence and intimidation against the customs officers. Ravinder's reckless move drags him deeper into trouble.

episodes.title: Kahani Khatam
episodes.description: Arjun gets crucial information from Srikant Saxena. As the syndicate tries one final gold smuggling run, can the officers stop them before it's too late?

movies.title: Black Adam
movies.synopsis: Freed from his magical prison, a champion with the powers of the gods toes the line between good and evil as the Justice Society tries to contain him.

movies.title: My Life With the Walter Boys
movies.synopsis: When a tragedy disrupts her life, a teen moves in with her guardian's big family in a small town and learns new lessons about love, hope and friendship.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.description: In the wake of a medical emergency, Jackie and Katherine fight to keep the fractured Walters together as they reassess their lives and what matters most.

episodes.title: Split Focus
episodes.description: Jackie struggles to keep up with school commitments as Cole hits a roadblock at the garage. Alex's fame opens the door to an exclusive event.

episodes.title: Fever Pitch
episodes.description: A high-octane hobby sparks friction at home. While George hits a recovery milestone, Jackie scouts the perfect location for a project close to her heart.

episodes.title: Screeching Tires and True Love
episodes.description: An unexpected visitor arrives for Jackie, sparking a mixed reaction from Cole. Kiley's well-intentioned gesture pushes Alex toward a rowdy crowd.

episodes.title: The Jackie and Cole Effect
episodes.description: Cole discovers a bargain in a barn. A surprise reunion at the ranch reopens old wounds. Jackie throws a party for Grace that takes an eventful turn.

episodes.title: Wide Open Spaces
episodes.description: With the rumor mill in full swing, tensions flare between Richard and Jackie over her future. Danny and Erin feel the strain of their shared secret.

episodes.title: Washout
