movies.synopsis: When an old card game comes to life, a family jumps back in time to a medieval village where they must unmask werewolves to secure their return home.

movies.title: Maharaja
movies.synopsis: When his prized possession gets stolen, a barber seeks help from the police, who jeer at his request — until they learn what they're really looking for.

movies.title: Radioactive Emergency
movies.synopsis: An invisible threat. A family of victims. Relentless scientists. When deadly radiation is unleashed in Goiânia, every life is at risk.
movies.creator: Gustavo Lipsztein

episodes.title: A Disaster Like Brazil Has Never Seen Before
episodes.description: While searching for scraps, two men discover a lead capsule containing a glowing blue powder — but their quest for profit soon takes a sinister turn.

episodes.title: When Are We Going Home?
episodes.description: As the news spreads, families are divided and panic grows in Goiânia. Meanwhile, Orenstein and his team discover danger lurking around every corner.

episodes.title: Are We Drinking Contaminated Water?
episodes.description: The crisis deepens as rumors spread about radiation in the city's water. Some riot against the doctors' methods, while others appeal to their compassion.

episodes.title: We Always Have Options
episodes.description: The crisis draws global attention and aid, but the path to a solution is rocky. Márcio gains firsthand insight into the lives of the isolated patients.

episodes.title: You Have to Trust Someone
episodes.description: One month into the crisis, tragedy unfolds, dividing the community's sympathies. Can a series of bold actions bring the nightmare closer to an end?

movies.title: Strong Girl Nam-soon
movies.synopsis: Gifted with superhuman strength, a young woman returns to Korea to find her birth family — only to be entangled in a drug case that could test her power.
movies.creator: Baek Mi-kyoung, Kim Jung-sik, Yi Kyoung-shic

episodes.title: Birth of the Strong Girl
episodes.description: Desperate for a reunion, Hwang Geum-ju seemingly finds her long-lost daughter. After discovering the truth, Gang Nam-soon prepares for her trip to Korea.

episodes.title: Gangnam, Here I Come
episodes.description: Nam-soon begins her search for her parents in Korea but experiences some roadblocks. Geum-ju suspects something's off with her newfound daughter.

episodes.title: Three Generations
episodes.description: The incident at the Han River puts a spotlight on Nam-soon. As Kang Hee-sik spends more time with Nam-soon, he connects the dots about her family.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: After a dramatic reunion, Nam-soon becomes closer to her family. As Hee-sik continues to investigate a drug case, Nam-soon lends her assistance.

episodes.title: Vigilante of Seoul
episodes.description: As Nam-soon assists Hee-sik in his drug investigation, she has a run-in with the ominous Ryu Si-o. Ri Hwa-ja plots her revenge against Nam-soon.

episodes.title: Mystery X
episodes.description: Hee-sik witnesses the jarring effects of the drug when it strikes his team leader. Nam-soon's search for evidence garners attention from foes.

episodes.title: Moonbow
episodes.description: Geum-ju pays a strategic visit to Si-o, who has his own motives. During a birthday dinner, Nam-soon's family questions her growing kinship with Hee-sik.

episodes.title: Light and Shadow of Gangnam
episodes.description: Hee-sik begins to worry about Nam-soon after Si-o promotes her into his inner circle. Geum-ju probes deeper into a suspicious businessman.

episodes.title: The Root of Vice
episodes.description: Nam-soon pulls off a bold heist, putting Si-o on high alert. During a tense meeting, Geum-ju challenges Si-o — who in return begins plotting his revenge.

episodes.title: The Stand-ins
episodes.description: Geum-ju falls victim to Si-o's attack, but proves she's one step ahead of him. As Nam-soon finally tracks down the drugs, her brother succumbs to them.

movies.title: American Manhunt: Osama bin Laden
movies.synopsis: In unprecedented detail, this thrilling documentary series goes behind the scenes of the historic special forces hunt for the world's most wanted man.

episodes.title: A New Kind of Enemy
episodes.description: In the wake of 9/11, CIA analysts trace the horrific attacks to al-Qaida and its leader, Osama bin Laden — and mount a daring effort to apprehend him.

episodes.title: Gloves Are Off
episodes.description: Frustration grows when the trail goes cold after the Battle of Tora Bora. As al-Qaida continues its global attacks, bin Laden plots his next move.

episodes.title: Operation Neptune Spear
episodes.description: Ten years after 9/11, a pivotal clue emerges in Pakistan. The president orders a highly classified — and risky — SEAL raid to take out bin Laden at last.

movies.title: Deva
movies.synopsis: Working on a complicated case, a fierce young police officer goes rogue to dismantle a lethal web of corruption and deceit — one epic battle at a time.

movies.title: Queen of Tears
movies.synopsis: The queen of department stores and her small-town husband weather a marital crisis —until love miraculously begins to bloom again.
movies.creator: Park Ji-eun, Jang Young-woo, Kim Hee-won

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Baek Hyun-woo and Hong Hae-in navigate a tense relationship, both at home and at work. But upon deciding his future, Hyun-woo pays a visit to his family.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: After Hae-in reveals her grim news to Hyun-woo, he begins to treat her nicely. Meanwhile, Hae-in's old classmate returns to Korea and joins Queens Group.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Hyun-woo discovers troubling evidence after saving Hae-in from a boar attack. Meanwhile, the two slowly find their long-lost feelings reigniting.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: As Yoon Eun-sung increasingly interlopes in Hae-in's life, Hyun-woo begins to feel jealous. Hae-in later shows up for Baek Du-gwan in his time of need.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: As Hyun-woo and Hae-in spend time in his hometown, they awkwardly navigate their complex feelings. Hae-in later receives bad news about her diagnosis.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Hyun-woo unexpectedly shows up in Berlin to secure a treatment for Hae-in. Meanwhile in Korea, Hong Man-dae faces a crisis at his company.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Feeling betrayed by Hyun-woo, Hae-in pushes him away and becomes cold. Back in Korea, Hyun-woo begins to unravel a scheme against Hae-in's family.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Despite being in a tense situation with Hae-in, Hyun-woo remains firm about staying in the company as his suspicions towards Eun-sung grow even stronger.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Hae-in and her family go into hiding in Hyun-woo’s hometown to figure out their next move. Eun-sung discovers the truth about Hae-in’s health.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: Eun-sung tracks down Hae-in, presenting her with an ultimatum. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo skillfully uses leverage to get Grace Ko on the Hong family’s side.

movies.title: The Railway Men - The Untold Story Of Bhopal 1984
movies.synopsis: After a deadly gas leaks from a factory in Bhopal, brave railway workers risk their lives to save others in the face of an unspeakable disaster.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: In the hours leading to the disaster, the Union Carbide higher-ups downplay safety concerns at the factory while unwitting souls hang in the balance.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: As the gas descends on the city, passengers at Bhopal Junction break into a frenzy for their lives — and a brave station master springs into action.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The gas holds the Bhopal passengers hostage while railway workers scramble to figure out a plan. Meanwhile, a visitor to India may have an antidote.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: As new threats rocket towards Bhopal Junction, the railway men face unthinkable dilemmas. Can they act quickly enough to save others — and themselves?

movies.title: The Apothecary Diaries
movies.synopsis: Obsessed with poison and medicine, a servant in the Emperor’s palace draws on her roots as a healer in the red light district to solve mysterious cases.

episodes.title: Maomao and Maomao
episodes.description: The ladies of the inner palace develop a keen interest in novels. Maomao joins Gyokuyou and her daughter Lingli for a walk and makes a new friend.

episodes.title: The Caravan
episodes.description: A caravan selling foreign goods comes to the inner palace. Later, after perfumed oils come into vogue, Maomao notices something odd about their smell.

episodes.title: Corpse Fungus
episodes.description: At Jinshi's request, Maomao investigates poisonous mushrooms growing near the inner palace. Later, she learns that a mid-ranking concubine has died.

episodes.title: Mirrors
episodes.description: Gaoshun asks Maomao to help solve a mystery involving two homebound sisters, one of whom has fallen pregnant despite being under strict surveillance.

episodes.title: The Moon Fairy
episodes.description: After encountering Shisui in the peach garden, Maomao realizes how to fulfill the foreign envoy's seemingly impossible request to see the moon spirit.

episodes.title: The Crystal Pavilion, for the Third Time
episodes.description: A court lady from the clinic asks Maomao to make some medicine for an ill Crystal Pavilion maid who stopped coming to work a few weeks prior.

episodes.title: The Shrine of Choosing
episodes.description: Having followed Xiaolan to the learning hall, Maomao meets an elderly eunuch who teaches there and becomes intrigued by the sight of a nearby shrine.

episodes.title: The Empress Dowager
episodes.description: As Maomao speaks with Shisui to clear up a rumor about an insect-catching court lady, they spot the empress dowager heading toward the clinic.

episodes.title: The Late Emperor
episodes.description: Maomao stays at Jinshi's residence while investigating the curse. As Suiren talks of Jinshi's childhood, Maomao finds an odd stone among his old toys.

episodes.title: Ghost Stories
episodes.description: Three new attendants join the Jade Pavilion. Later, Yinghua brings Maomao to an old building where court ladies have gathered to share scary stories.

movies.title: Mr. & Mrs. Mahi
movies.synopsis: When a washed-up cricketer discovers his newlywed wife’s talent on the pitch, he begins to coach her. But his resentment grows as she starts to shine.

movies.title: The Nun II
movies.synopsis: Four years after its first defeat, demon Valek returns to terrorize students at a remote boarding school — until Sister Irene arrives to banish it again.

movies.title: Meiyazhagan
movies.synopsis: A man makes a bittersweet journey back to his hometown after 22 years and meets an insistent yet kindhearted relative whose name he can't remember.

movies.title: De De Pyaar De 2
movies.synopsis: Age is just a number — but when Ayesha's parents find out just how old her boyfriend Ashish is, they'll do whatever it takes to break them up.

movies.title: Bet
movies.synopsis: At a school ruled by teen gamblers, Yumeko keeps her cards close and her enemies closer... and she's playing them all. Based on the manga "Kakegurui."

episodes.title: Game On
episodes.description: After arriving at St. Dominic's Prep, new student Yumeko scopes out the rules, sizes up the competition and sets her sights on climbing the leaderboard.

episodes.title: Icebreaker
episodes.description: Suki turns up the heat and challenges Yumeko to a chilling game designed to expose a player's darkest secrets. Mary adjusts to life as a house pet.

episodes.title: First Blood
episodes.description: Tragic news has the school buzzing with gossip — and off-the-books side bets. Yumeko dances with danger. Kira fights to keep the upper hand.

episodes.title: The Recital
episodes.description: Someone makes a spicy wager on Ryan's birthday: Will he lose his virginity by midnight? Meanwhile, Yumeko sets a deadly trap — and Riri hunts for a rat.

episodes.title: House Wars
episodes.description: Diamonds. Clubs. Hearts. Spades. A ruthless game of capture the flag between houses finds Michael and Yumeko on opposite sides.

episodes.title: The Bet Gala
episodes.description: It's a night of surprises — and shocking reveals — at a stylish school dance for kings and queens where only one royal can reign supreme.

episodes.title: The Hunt
episodes.description: A desperate Yumeko risks it all to compete in an openly hostile House Pet Hunt. Elsewhere, armed with a map, Michael embarks on a mission.

episodes.title: The Speakeasy
episodes.description: With time running out to make the Top Ten before the end of term, Yumeko unlocks a St. Dominic's secret that could change the rules of the game.

episodes.title: Meet the Parents
episodes.description: At the school board retreat, revenge is so close that Yumeko can almost taste it. Can Ryan and Michael stop her from making a fatal mistake?

episodes.title: Winner Takes All
episodes.description: Every second counts as Kira and Yumeko take on their toughest opponents to date: each other. As for the stakes? They've never been deadlier.

movies.title: My Demon
movies.synopsis: A pitiless demon becomes powerless after getting entangled with an icy heiress, who may hold the key to his lost abilities — and his heart.
movies.creator: Choi A-il, Kim Jang-han, Kwon Da-som

episodes.title: Living in the Mist
episodes.description: An accidental date with Jeong Gu-won leaves Do Do-Hee feeling flustered. She later becomes a victim of an attack — where a rescue requires a contract.

episodes.title: Everyone Has a Demon in Their Heart
episodes.description: Gu-won inexplicably loses his power — and finds that Do-hee might be the key to regaining it. But his efforts to take back his abilities backfire.

episodes.title: Joining Hands With a Demon
episodes.description: After another attack, Do-hee asks Gu-won to be her guard — even after his admission as a demon. Do-hee finds the loss of someone close suspicious.

episodes.title: Sweet but Dangerous
episodes.description: Do-hee proposes to Gu-won, but he refuses. She later recruits him to investigate Ju Cheon-suk's death, but he faces an unexpected power blockage.

episodes.title: Only You
episodes.description: After a dramatic rescue, Gu-won and Do-hee begin having complex feelings for each other. Do-hee later tries to find a man to marry — frustrating Gu-won.

episodes.title: Into the Wheel of Fortune
episodes.description: After Gu-won saves Do-hee's life, she receives competing marriage proposals. She ends up choosing one, and finds an alarming face at her wedding.

episodes.title: Stained Relationships
episodes.description: Do-hee and Gu-won go through newlywed pains as they move in together. Ju Seok-hoon begins to suspect Gu-won's non-human identity.

episodes.title: The Fateful Choice
episodes.description: After a sudden attack on Gu-won, Do-hee rushes to save his life — and as life around her becomes more dangerous, she makes a surprising career move.

episodes.title: The Unmasked Truth
episodes.description: As Do-hee and Gu-won's relationship finally blossoms, Gu-won begins to experience a strange change in his powers — all amidst a larger looming threat.

episodes.title: Breaking Through the Shell
episodes.description: Upon discovering his fate, Gu-won tries to find another way to save himself. But just as he and Do-hee prepare their ritual, she becomes a target.

movies.title: Voicemails for Isabelle
movies.synopsis: A young baker dishes on her chaotic life via voicemails to her late sister, unaware the number now has a new owner… and he's falling in love with her.

movies.title: Amaran (SK21)
movies.synopsis: Honor, love and sacrifice collide as Major Mukund Varadarajan and his wife, Indhu, navigate an emotional romance amidst his rise within the Indian army.

movies.title: The Final Problem
movies.synopsis: Once Spain's most iconic Sherlock Holmes, actor Benjamin Basil becomes drawn into a real murder investigation at a hotel where no one can be trusted.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Benjamin Basil travels to Mallorca hoping to relaunch his career, but a death turns the actor into a detective and the hotel guests into suspects.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: After a murder weapon appears in his room, Benjamin fears the killer will strike again. Vicky makes an accusation, but somehow it doesn't add up.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The hotel resorts to drastic measures as the police finally get in touch. Benjamin and the guests grow increasingly suspicious of one another.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Benjamin can't leave behind what happened in Santa Águeda. The shooting of a new film reveals everyone's true colors and resolves the final problem.

movies.title: My Secret Santa
movies.synopsis: "Virgin River" star Alexandra Breckenridge plays a single mom who dons a jolly disguise to land a desperately needed Santa gig from a dashing hotel heir.

movies.title: Lust Stories 3
movies.synopsis: Four eminent Indian directors explore sex, relationships, desire and love through short films in this sequel to 2018's Emmy-nominated "Lust Stories."

movies.title: The Great Indian Kapil Show
movies.synopsis: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.
movies.creator: Kapil Sharma

episodes.title: Hassi Ka Tyohaar - With Ajay Devgn
episodes.description: The celebrations begin as Ajay Devgn, Shriya Saran, Jaideep Ahlawat and the cast of Drishyam 3 join Kapil for a season-opening riot of festive fun.

episodes.title: Into the Vvan: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia
episodes.description: The festivities roar on as Tamannaah Bhatia, Sidharth Malhotra and the cast of "The Vvaan - Force Of The Forrest" join Kapil for a wild bout of fun.

episodes.title: Beyond the Boundary - Ravi Shastri and Sunil Gavaskar
episodes.description: Ravi Shastri makes his debut on the show with Sunil Gavaskar for some cricket banter, locker-room secrets and plenty of festive fun.

episodes.title: Royally Funny - Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan
episodes.description: Opposites attract! Saif and Kareena bring 14 years of couple quirks, cheeky jabs and rare revelations to Kapil's stage in a must-watch celebration!

movies.title: The Museum of Innocence
movies.synopsis: A man's forbidden longing for a young woman drives him to collect mementos of their bond in this intimate take on Nobel-winning Orhan Pamuk's novel.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: With Kemal and Sibel's long-awaited engagement arrangements underway, a chance encounter with a familiar face puts a new spring in Kemal's step.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Füsun's secret visits become more frequent — along with her worries — and Kemal finds himself blissfully slipping into unchartered territories.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The mortality of love begins to reveal itself, when Kemal finds out that his father has been keeping a secret. Füsun receives a heartbreaking invitation.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Emotions run high at Sibel and Kemal's engagement party. While Sibel spends her time matchmaking her friends, Kemal learns that he can't have it all.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Lost in his melancholy, Kemal confesses the true nature of his time at the Merhamet Apartments. But is forgiveness enough to save his relationship?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Füsun's invitation is veiled with heartbreak and longing, yet reveals itself to be nothing but an ulterior motive. Love is closer and further than ever.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: A newspaper column brings Kemal's shame to light, but when he is ostracized by his own friends, he discovers that there are even more secrets to uncover.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: When an opportunity presents itself, Kemal convinces his mother to make amends with her cousin. Finally true happiness seems within his grasp.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Kemal's museum of broken-hearted memories and trinkets of innocence becomes a physical dedication to the ultimate love story — a decade in the making.

movies.title: Run Away
movies.synopsis: A desperate father searching for his runaway daughter gets caught up in a murder case — and stumbles upon secrets which could destroy his family for good.
movies.creator: Harlan Coben

episodes.title: Seeing Is Believing
episodes.description: Simon Greene's violent attempt to bring his runaway daughter home goes viral. Another desperate father hires PI Elena Ravenscroft to find his son.

episodes.title: Tattoos While U Wait
episodes.description: The Greenes are rushed to hospital, where Simon is confronted by the police. Elena discovers a connection between Henry and another missing person.

episodes.title: Breaking Point
episodes.description: Elena makes an unwelcome late-night visit to Maria. Simon reluctantly attends a memorial service and learns some unsettling news about Paige.

episodes.title: A Different Time
episodes.description: Simon learns about his daughter's life at university — and his wife's secret. Dee Dee and Ash put a violent end to a chapter of their traumatic past.

episodes.title: Forever Be The Shining Truth
episodes.description: Elena confronts her mother-in-law and visits an adoption agency as Simon collects samples. Isaac questions an old friend about Luther's shooting.

episodes.title: The Man I Knew
episodes.description: Elena joins the dots between the murdered and the missing. Simon's kids track down Paige's professor, who shares a shocking truth about her time at uni.

episodes.title: Sliding Doors
episodes.description: Dee Dee comes clean to Ash, and zeroes in on a new target. The police find a lead connected to the Shining Truth, and Simon returns to Rocco's basement.

episodes.title: It Stays With Us
episodes.description: As the police close in on the Shining Haven, missing pieces fall into place and hidden truths come to light — but some threaten to stay buried forever.

movies.title: K.O.
movies.synopsis: MMA heavyweight champ Ciryl Gane plays a disgraced fighter determined to find a missing teen who's involved with a mercilessly violent criminal gang.

movies.title: Little House on the Prairie
movies.synopsis: Equal parts family saga and frontier adventure, this heartfelt series brings Laura Ingalls Wilder's beloved novels to life for a new generation.
movies.creator: Rebecca Sonnenshine

episodes.title: Independence
episodes.description: The Ingalls family trades Wisconsin's woods for the wide-open plains of Kansas, where their new life brings both breathtaking beauty and genuine danger.

episodes.title: The House on the Prairie
episodes.description: A neighbor steps up to help the Ingalls build their new home, but their growing bond is threatened by the shadows of his past — and Caroline's.

episodes.title: News of the World
episodes.description: As the house on the prairie approaches completion, a troubling encounter makes the family reconsider their decision to settle in Independence.

episodes.title: Life Let Us Cherish
episodes.description: With fever gripping the town and medicine in short supply, the Ingalls face their most perilous challenge yet.

episodes.title: A Circle of Blue Sky
episodes.description: Caroline and the girls struggle to fit in at a ladies' event. Charles sets out to find the family's missing horses — and clear an innocent man's name.

episodes.title: Peace on Earth
episodes.description: Snowed in and far from family, the Ingalls try to find a little cheer on a quiet Christmas Eve. But Santa has a surprise or two in store.

episodes.title: A Softer Note in the Sound of the Wind
episodes.description: The Osage gather for a pivotal tribal council, with the fate of the land — and Laura's friendship with Good Eagle — in the balance.

episodes.title: This is Now
episodes.description: After catching wind of their parents' debts, Laura and Mary resolve to save the day by winning prize money at the town's first Founder's Day.

movies.title: Genie, Make a Wish
movies.synopsis: A woman becomes the master of a genie who keeps tempting her to make a wish — sparking a risky, magical connection. From Kim Eun-sook ("The Glory").
movies.creator: Kim Eun-sook

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: After a lifetime of abandonment, Ki Ka-young confronts her mother in Dubai. During her trip, she releases Iblis, indifferent to any wish he might grant.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Back at Ka-young's home, Iblis learns about her past from the locals — and navigates modern Korean society while trying to threaten a wish from her.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Iblis agrees to grant Ka-young's first wish — to corrupt others — although she remains an enigma. Meanwhile, Ejllael plots his revenge against Iblis.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: After sharing her first kiss with Iblis, Ka-young searches for any excuse to kiss him again. Ejllael struggles to sway Ka-young to his long-held plan.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Ka-young makes her second wish — this time for her grandmother. Meanwhile, Iblis continues corrupting others in a bid to win his bet with Ka-young.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Iblis seeks Ejllael to probe his missing years with Ka‑young. Meanwhile, Ka‑young faces memories of her past life — and a fateful wish.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Despite learning of her past, Ka-young suspects there's more to her story with Iblis. Ejllael and Iblis discover a secret force lurking in the shadows.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Iblis and Ka-young travel to Dubai for answers about their unaccounted past. Soon, Ka-young begins to feel an unexpected bond with him.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Ejllael uses Oh Pan-geum as bait to bring down Iblis. As Khalid's threat grows, Iblis and Ka-young uncover a major clue about their past connection.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: With Khalid's next move imminent, Iblis and Ka-young dig into their blurry past. Meanwhile, Pan-geum prepares for her fate, stoking suspicion around her.

movies.title: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
movies.synopsis: At half-time in the 2005 Champions League final, Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history — as players recall in this documentary.

movies.title: Made in Korea
movies.synopsis: A woman from a small town in Tamil Nadu moves to South Korea — a place she always dreamed of — but struggles to find her footing in a foreign land.

movies.title: Elite Force
movies.synopsis: The past catches up with an elite unit as a set of new recruits joins its ranks in this explosive drama series directed by Julien Leclercq ("Ganglands").
movies.creator: Julien Leclercq, Sylvain Caron

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: David, a high-ranking GIGN officer, is preparing to leave field operations. But a new recruit's graduation and a shocking attack threaten his plans.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Devastated by the previous night's events and under new scrutiny, the squad tracks down a suspect. On a mission, Max disobeys a direct order from David.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: After the forest shootout, David pockets key evidence. Max continues to question his father's death, and a hospital visit takes an ominous turn.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Having linked the mastermind behind the attacks to an old operation, David goes on a rogue mission – but he's not the only one searching for answers.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: David faces the consequences of his actions. Brought in for questioning, he tries to protect Max, and finally tells his godson the whole truth.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: As news of a hostage situation reaches the squad, they race to launch a rescue mission and take down a skilled assassin who has nothing left to lose.

movies.title: Animals
movies.synopsis: Director Ben Affleck stars with Kerry Washington in this thriller about an LA political couple whose moral compass cracks when their son is kidnapped.

movies.title: Raid 2
movies.synopsis: Transferred to a small town in Rajasthan, an honest income tax officer pursues a beloved politician whose public good deeds conceal rampant corruption.

movies.title: Maa
movies.synopsis: In a cursed village, a mother must summon the power of a goddess when a child-stealing demonic force threatens the life of her daughter.

movies.title: Shaitaan
movies.synopsis: A family's getaway turns terrifying when an intruder possesses the teen daughter's body, putting her at the mercy of his increasingly sinister commands.

movies.title: GOAT - The Greatest of All Time
movies.synopsis: He was his agency's top hostage negotiator, field agent and spy — but years after retiring, one mission brings his past back to haunt him and his family.

movies.title: Dragon
movies.synopsis: After a top student faces rejection and heartbreak, he cons his way into a finance career. But keeping up the facade proves tricky as the lies build.

movies.title: Shaque: Trust No One
movies.synopsis: When her newborn vanishes from a hospital, a mother unearths chilling secrets close to home in this mystery thriller starring Parineeti Chopra.
movies.creator: Rensil D'Silva, Siddharth P Malhotra

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: After their newborn disappears from the hospital, Anvita and Alok receive disturbing birthday packages each year that keep the search alive.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: A potential lead forces Anvita to question her search for her missing daughter. Meanwhile, Madhu escalates her efforts to halt the investigation.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Anvita's suspicions grow as she examines an old photo for clues, while her visions intensify. A mysterious death raises flags for Inspector Khurana.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: An unexpected confession adds a new layer to the case. Apeksha's birthday party is thrown into turmoil when Anvita makes a shocking accusation.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: A threatening message deepens the rift between Anvita and Alok while she seeks crucial evidence. The police track down a woman tied to Rhea's birth.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: As the mystery behind Anvita's hallucinations unravels, Madhu finds herself cornered. A tragic incident disrupts the investigation.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Shreya's revelation begins to connect the pieces of Apeksha's disappearance as the truth finally comes to light.

movies.title: War Machine
movies.synopsis: An Army Ranger candidate ("Reacher" star Alan Ritchson) fights to save his team from a colossal mechanized predator hunting them over rough terrain.

movies.title: Tere Ishk Mein
movies.synopsis: A hot-headed fighter pilot and a psychologist confront their turbulent romantic past when they meet years later — with new lives and unresolved feelings.

movies.title: The East Palace
movies.synopsis: Resentful spirits. Mysterious deaths. Decades-old secrets. As evil curse grips the palace, can a spirit slayer and a court lady stop the deaths?
movies.creator: Choi Jung-kyu, Kwon So-ra, Seo Jea-won

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: After a mysterious death, the king summons the spirit slayer Gu-cheon to banish the pond spirit. Saeng-gang, who hears the dead, also appears before him.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: After a close call while pursuing the pond spirit, Gu-cheon makes a pact with Saeng-gang. Later, they uncover the truth behind the salt storehouse ghost.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The king orders Gu-cheon to save the prince — or die. Forced to enter the spirit realm, he comes face-to-face with the ghost of a former royal guard.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang attempt to seal the pond spirit for good. Still suspicious about the crown princes' deaths, Gu-cheon returns to Saeng-gang.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Gu-cheon escapes danger with Saeng-gang's help. As the king falls ill, Gu-cheon fights the evil spirit — only for a guardian spirit to stand in his way.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: During Gu-cheon's fight, Saeng-gang comes under threat — bringing them closer to the truth. But Gu-cheon loses his sight, putting their mission at risk.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: The king and queen dowager clash over the tragedies as resentful spirits close in. Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang steel themselves for a final confrontation.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Chaos engulfs the palace as the vengeful spirit moves to devour everything in its path. Can Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang stop him before it's too late?

movies.title: Maareesan
movies.synopsis: In this Tamil thriller, a man with Alzheimer's accepts a ride out of town from a stranger. But the journey turns sour when their intentions clash.

movies.title: Death of a Unicorn
movies.synopsis: A father (Paul Rudd) and his daughter (Jenna Ortega) accidentally kill a unicorn with healing powers that spark hope — and greed — in his dying boss.

movies.title: Sunny Sanskari ki Tulsi Kumari
movies.synopsis: As Sunny (Varun Dhawan) and Tulsi (Janhvi Kapoor) plan to upstage their exes' wedding, they realize they have more in common than heartbreak.

movies.title: Gandhari
movies.synopsis: In this suspenseful thriller, a mother's search for her daughter pulls her into the heart of a harrowing network of child kidnappings in Joypurra.

movies.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
movies.synopsis: A college student struggling with recurring nightmares discovers that Death has been hunting her family for generations — and now it's her turn.

movies.title: Dude
movies.synopsis: Childhood friends Agan and Kural reach a crossroads when unexpected feelings and family pressure threaten to upend their relationship.

movies.title: Retro
movies.synopsis: A former gangster (Suriya) fights for the woman (Pooja Hegde) he loves and a life of peace in this thrilling action-romance from the director of "Petta."

movies.title: Chhaava
movies.synopsis: After the death of his father, warrior-king Sambhaji Maharaj battles Mughal forces led by Aurangzeb to keep the Maratha Empire alive.

movies.title: Good Bad Ugly
movies.synopsis: After several years in prison, a former gangster seeks a quiet life with his family. But when his son winds up in jail, he must return to his old ways.

movies.title: They Call Him OG
movies.synopsis: After years of silence, his enemies thought he'd gone for good — but Ojas Gambheera (Pawan Kalyan) is back, and he's out for revenge.

movies.title: Cocktail 2
movies.synopsis: This romantic drama follows a longtime couple whose trip to Sicily becomes a trial of love and commitment after they reunite with an old college friend.

movies.title: The Last House
movies.synopsis: A family mysteriously sealed inside their home must work together to survive dwindling resources and the ominous force keeping them trapped.

movies.title: Reporting Live
movies.synopsis: A deadly bridge collapse. A ruthless criminal syndicate. A network of corruption. Can two journalists expose the truth connecting them all?

movies.title: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai
movies.synopsis: The world's strongest underground fighters face off against a legendary samurai resurrected in the modern era. Based on Keisuke Itagaki's hit manga.

episodes.title: The Unstoppable Yawn
episodes.description: With the greatest father-son battle on earth concluded, Baki experiences overwhelming boredom. Meanwhile, Tokugawa advances his unprecedented experiment.

episodes.title: THE BEAT
episodes.description: As the other martial artists battle restlessness, Kaoru Hanayama asks Tokugawa for a favor. Deep underground, the cloning project enters its final phase.

episodes.title: The Countenance of Musashi
episodes.description: As Professor John accepts Sabuko's arcane methods against scientific reasoning, Hanayama gears up for an all-out fistfight with Yujiro on Tokyo's streets.

episodes.title: Boy
episodes.description: After facing Japan's greatest modern swordsman, the peerless Musashi Miyamoto demands the most skilled fighters in the country. Baki steps forward.

episodes.title: Otherworldly Strength
episodes.description: Baki unleashes his fastest strike — but the samurai is faster. Later, as Musashi roams the city, his actions catch the attention of other martial artists.

episodes.title: Real Sword
episodes.description: The first to move is Doppo Orochi. After a brief tussle, he asks Musashi to use a real blade. How will God's Hand fare against the sword saint's steel?

episodes.title: Feather
episodes.description: Sea King Retsu arrives to face Musashi and trains intensively under the watchful eye of Sea Emperor Kaku to master the secret technique: Xiaoli.

episodes.title: You Are Defeated!
episodes.description: The battle between kenpo master Retsu and sword master Musashi Miyamoto begins! While Retsu unleashes long-range weapon attacks, Musashi closes in!?

episodes.title: Sea King Retsu
episodes.description: Barely standing after Musashi's barrage of brutal attacks, Retsu forces his broken body forward and adopts a familiar stance. Can he turn the tide?

episodes.title: Sekigahara
episodes.description: The deathmatch between Retsu and Musashi comes to a devastatingly brutal conclusion. Baki visits Izo Motobe for guidance and flies into a rage.

movies.title: Man Vs Baby
movies.synopsis: Trevor's back, baby! Heartfelt mishaps and Christmas capers abound as comedy legend Rowan Atkinson returns for another chaotic house-sitting experience.
movies.creator: Will Davies, Rowan Atkinson

episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.description: Trevor's Christmas preparations take an unexpected turn when he's left in charge of a lost baby just as a lucrative house-sitting offer falls in his lap.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.description: After passing the house-sitter interview while keeping the rascally baby out of sight, Trevor faces his next challenge: changing nappies.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.description: If being locked out of the penthouse and dealing with nightly intruders wasn't enough, an unfortunate mix-up leads Trevor to part with the wrong baby.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.description: An unexpected bit of news from the penthouse owners sends Trevor into a mad scramble to save Christmas — and the baby — from disaster.

movies.title: Viral Hit
movies.synopsis: Bullied. Broke. Brave? Shimura starts livestreaming fights to pay his mom's medical bills in this drama directed and written by the "Cells at Work!" team.

episodes.title: Do You Want to Become Stronger?
episodes.description: Shimura endures daily torment from school tyrant Hamaken. But his luck changes when a scuffle with bootlicker Kanegon accidentally goes live — and viral.

episodes.title: Fan the Flames of Anger
episodes.description: Mugged by delinquents, Shimura follows TOU-KEI's teachings to fight back. Later, despite landing a blow on Hamaken, Shimura lands in even deeper trouble.

episodes.title: I'm Not a Loser!
episodes.description: Humiliated in front of his crush, Shimura disappears. As everyone searches desperately for him, Kanegon endures brutal violence from Hamaken.

episodes.title: Well Then, My Friend
episodes.description: Viral Hit faces its first crisis and Shimura must take on multiple opponents. Later, ex-taekwondo champ Shinjo targets them and attacks Kanegon.

episodes.title: The Original Viral Hit
episodes.description: The Shimura vs. Shinjo fight reaches a shocking conclusion. Viral Hit reaches 1M subscribers, and the head of BAD FELLOWS approaches with a proposition.

episodes.title: This is My Youth
episodes.description: As the final battle nears, Shimura's group face mounting challenges. TOU-KEI's secret emerges and their last fight begins — for friends, family and love.

movies.title: Office Romance
movies.synopsis: In an office with a strict no-dating policy, is it worse to get caught… or catch feelings? Jennifer Lopez and Brett Goldstein star in this cheeky rom-com.

movies.title: Teach You a Lesson
movies.synopsis: Na Hwa-jin (Kim Moo-yul) puts his special ops skills to use when he joins a bureau that does whatever it takes to restore respect in broken schools.
movies.creator: Hong Jong-chan, Lee Nam-kyu, Kim Da-hee, Moon Jong-ho

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Inspector Na Hwa-jin steps into the chaos and takes control of a school plagued by the spoiled son of a powerful politician — to teach him a lesson.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: With unassuming Bong Geun-dae on his side, Hwa-jin uses his special ops skills to handle a school gang and defend a student who just wants to study.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: When a teen influencer spreads false claims about her teachers, the team's loose-cannon Inspector Im Han-rim steps in to set the record straight.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Choi Gang-seok weathers a political attack on his bureau. Hwa-jin's team visits an elite school to uncover why a student attacked a respected teacher.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: When an elementary school teacher's spirit wears down under pressure, Hwa-jin steps in to be her substitute — turning the tables to solve the case.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Four juvenile delinquents think they're above the law — until the team takes an interest in their extracurricular crimes and gives a harsh reality check.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Geun-dae goes undercover to help a father find his gambling addict son. To undermine the bureau politically, Hwang Gi-tae visits a juvenile inmate.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: After a pre-med student collapses in class, Hwa-jin investigates his obsessive mother, whose access to illicit pills hints at a larger conspiracy.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: To help a student escape his exploitative friends, Han-rim adopts a new persona to join his circle. Cho Gyu-cheol's return puts the bureau in danger.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: After public backlash hits the bureau, Hwa-jin and his team go rogue to expose a deadly conspiracy led by a violent student-run gang.

movies.title: The WONDERfools
movies.synopsis: Teleportation. Strength. Stickiness. When a group of misfits suddenly gains superpowers, can they take on the villains threatening Haeseong City?
movies.creator: Yoo In-sik, Kang Eun-kyung, Huh Dah-joong

episodes.title: Every Life Comes With a Surprise Twist
episodes.description: When news of the apocalypse spreads in Haeseong City, a cash-strapped and terminally ill young woman devises a kidnapping plot with two clumsy sidekicks.

episodes.title: Secrets Are Meant To Be Kept
episodes.description: Eun Chae-ni and her quirky friends Son Gyeong-hun and Kang Ro-bin are baffled by their sudden abilities. A wary Lee Un-jeong confronts his doubts.

episodes.title: Brutes and Bad Luck Do Come in Droves
episodes.description: The gang witnesses Un-jeong's superpower in a crisis. While they're thrilled after a daring rescue, Un-jeong senses danger nearby.

episodes.title: Boon the King Duck vs Wunderkinder
episodes.description: Dr. Ha Won-do returns after 20 years, chasing secrets of the Child of Eternity. Later, the gang faces an attack — still unsure of their powers.

episodes.title: All We Need Is You
episodes.description: Un-jeong leads a bootcamp for the gang to tap into their abilities. Chae-ni confronts her grandma about the superpower's secret.

episodes.title: All Roads Lead to Chae-ni
episodes.description: Chae-ni wakes up to danger — but finds a surprise lifeline in her pocket. Un-jeong plans with Gyeong-hun and Ro-bin to rescue Chae-ni.

episodes.title: The Guardians of Haeseong City Part 1
episodes.description: Un-jeong and the gang fight other superpowered followers, while Dr. Ha's risky plan targets Chae-ni.

episodes.title: The Guardians of Haeseong City Part 2
episodes.description: New Year's Eve 1999. Three misfits use their abilities to battle superpowered villains in an all-out brawl for Haeseong City.

movies.title: Border 2
movies.synopsis: At a rural outpost, three soldiers in the Indian military prepare to lay down their lives for their country's contested borders. Starring Sunny Deol.

movies.title: HIT: The Third Case
movies.synopsis: Hardened cop Arjun Sarkaar of the elite Homicide Intervention Team takes on a high-pressure case: a series of gruesome murders in Jammu and Kashmir.

movies.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule (Reloaded Version)
movies.synopsis: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

movies.title: Bhooth Bangla
movies.synopsis: When Arjun's sister's wedding is threatened by a demon, he must uncover the truth behind the curse that has plagued their village for generations.

movies.title: Take Charge of My Heart
movies.synopsis: Kim Young-kwang ("Trigger") stars as a competent heir with just one weakness: his artificial heart always threatens to run out of charge.
movies.creator: Park Soo-won, Song You-chae

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Na Bo-bae is a struggling writer — and human electrical conductor. Suddenly, she bumps into Baek Ho-rang, the first person who's immune to her sparks.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: When Ho-rang realizes that Bo-bae's strange powers could be the solution to his heart-battery needs, he tries to make her an offer she can't refuse.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Ho-rang and Bo-bae become roommates and make things official. As per their contract, they go on their first date for Bo-bae's romance research.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Bo-bae ends up as Ho-rang's personal assistant. After a tense birthday lunch with his family, Ho-rang is moved by Bo-bae's simple surprise.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Han Seol-hee comes to Ho-rang with a marriage proposal, but he makes his disinterest clear. Meanwhile, Ji Eun-ho tries to draw closer to Bo-bae.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Bo-bae impresses with her writing skills, but seeing Bo-bae and Eun-ho's bond up close ignites jealous sparks within Ho-rang. Eun-ho makes a bold move.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Worried about endangering yet another person she cares about, Bo-bae keeps her distance from Ho-rang. Do-yoon and Seol-hee's schemes come to a head.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Bo-bae and Ho-rang finally start dating. Ho-rang prepares for his succession announcement — but on the day of the event, Bo-bae is nowhere to be found.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: Ho-rang's collapse puts him in serious danger — until Bo-bae arrives in the nick of time. But she soon finds out a dangerous truth about her powers.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: When Bo-bae learns her powers may be gone, she wonders what it means for her — and her future with Ho-rang. Will her story have a happy ending after all?

movies.title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
movies.synopsis: An aspiring comedian seeks to solve the mystery of his dying grandfather's lost love and bring closure to a story rooted in the 1947 Partition of India.

movies.title: Alpha
movies.synopsis: After enduring military experiments as a child, an elite assassin hunts those responsible, only to confront a past she never knew.

movies.title: Mardaani 3
movies.synopsis: Fearless cop Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down a ruthless criminal network responsible for kidnapping more than 90 girls across the country.

movies.title: Musafir Cafe
movies.synopsis: Years after an intense romance changed his life, a café owner (Vikrant Massey) finds a new path in the hills. Based on Divya Prakash Dubey's novel.
movies.creator: Sharanya Rajgopal

episodes.title: Arrival
episodes.description: Sudha sweeps Chander off his feet, but they choose to stay friends. Now, he runs a hilltop café with Preeti by his side.

episodes.title: Stay
episodes.description: While living with Chander, Sudha grows closer to him, but an opportunity in Mumbai may reshape their future. Preeti reveals her plans to expand the café.

episodes.title: Choice
episodes.description: Sudha grapples with a difficult choice between her career and love life, as Chander opens up about his plans for the future.

episodes.title: Trip
episodes.description: Rahil plants seeds of doubt in Preeti's mind, leading her to question Chander about his past. Sudha and Chander take a major step in their relationship.

episodes.title: Surprise
episodes.description: When his mother arrives unexpectedly, Chander scrambles to hide his relationship. Meanwhile, Rahil and Chander look back on how far they've come.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.description: Preeti and Chander receive a surprising offer for the café. A conversation with her mother leaves Sudha reflecting on an important choice.

episodes.title: Distance
episodes.description: While vacationing at a homestay, Sudha and Chander scout locations for the café, but a decision creates tension. Mark gives Chander a ring for Preeti.

episodes.title: Arrival
episodes.description: A surprise guest unsettles Preeti, while Chander finds his past unexpectedly colliding with the present.

movies.title: Saiyaara
movies.synopsis: Fame threatens to ruin the deep love between a musician and the woman who inspired his success in this drama directed by Mohit Suri ("Aashiqui 2").

movies.title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
movies.synopsis: After time traveling to the Joseon era, a talented chef meets a tyrant king. Her modern dishes captivate his palate, but royal challenges await her.
movies.creator: Chang Tae-you, fGRD

episodes.title: Course Nº 1 Gochujang Butter Bibimbap
episodes.description: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

episodes.title: Course N° 2 Sous Vide Cuisine
episodes.description: Held captive in harsh conditions, Ji-young prepares a feast to win her freedom — but even her talent can't save her when a crisis puts her life in peril.

episodes.title: Course N° 3 Haute Cuisine
episodes.description: Ji-young becomes Yi Heon's new chief royal cook after impressing him with her French cuisine. But Kang Mok-ju, consumed by jealousy, plots against her.

episodes.title: Course N° 4 **** and Spinach Doenjang Soup
episodes.description: A high-stakes royal cooking competition awaits Ji-young and her fate at court hangs in the balance. Later, a troubled Yi Heon drunkenly summons her.

episodes.title: Course N° 5 Snowflake Schnitzel
episodes.description: After an intimate moment together, Yi Heon begins rejecting Ji-young's meals — but soon find their minds wandering toward each other amid the distance.

episodes.title: Course N° 6 Black Sesame Macaron
episodes.description: When the Ming envoy demands a cooking contest, Ji-young rises to the challenge to represent Joseon — and win what Yi Heon has promised her.

episodes.title: Course N° 7 Dongnae Pajeon on a Rainy Day
episodes.description: In order to gain an edge in the cooking competition, Ji-young sets out to create a unique pot. However, finding the right craftsman proves difficult.

episodes.title: Course N° 8 Rice Wine Beef Bourguignon
episodes.description: Barely making it to the competition, Ji-young begins cooking — only to find her crucial ingredients missing. Can she overcome the crisis?

episodes.title: Course N° 9 Pressure-Cooked Ogyetang
episodes.description: Yi Heon shocks everyone by asking chefs to judge their own dishes. As time slips away in the intense battle, Ji-young considers plan B for her recipe.

episodes.title: Course N° 10 Joseon Restaurant
episodes.description: Yi Heon and Ji-young's bond deepens as he fights to prove her innocence — but can they uncover the cause of Grand Prince Jinmyeong's illness in time?

movies.title: Idli Kadai
movies.synopsis: Help run a corporate empire or enjoy the quiet life of a small-town chef? Murugan (Dhanush) must choose the right path for him in this family dramedy.

movies.title: Jaat
movies.synopsis: A mysterious stranger journeys to a remote town controlled by a callous crime lord, with one violent mission — restoring justice to its people.

movies.title: Vishwanath & Sons
movies.synopsis: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

movies.title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
movies.synopsis: A man helps a friend by posing as her lover while trying to keep it a secret from his wife — leading to misunderstandings that threaten his marriage.

movies.title: Money Trap
movies.synopsis: Chasing a mythic fortune, Asım's con-crew must decode an ancient map before rival treasure hunters find him, in this high stakes action-comedy series.
movies.creator: Yılmaz Erdoğan

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Asım and his gang get their hands on a mysterious map believed to lead to a Karun treasure — but is the relic real or just an old piece of leather?

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Still unsure about the validity of the map, Asım decides to recruit the expertise of Sado — the chaotic leader of the rule-breaking Gebeş family.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The chase for a prized bird begins, when Asım's best chance at some quick cash takes flight. Nefise Balamar and Asım strike a deal for the coveted map.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Saruhan traps Asım in a water tank as punishment, but Sampiyon makes a well-timed appearance. A kidnapped cryptologist reveals the myth behind the map.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Asım's delicate state encourages Nazlı to finally make amends with her father. Nefise finds out that having a copy of the map is of no use to her.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Saruhan and Asım come face to face again as negotiations for the map get underway, but when Nazlı is kidnapped the stakes are suddenly much higher.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: A riddle is decoded and suddenly the map is seen through a new light. While the gang celebrates Nazlı is unable to see eye to eye with her father's ambitions.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: An unlikely allyship forms as Asım and Saruhan outrun their rivals and follow the map's clues across Istanbul, in search of the Karun treasure.

movies.title: Facing El Chapo
movies.synopsis: Suspicious of his new partner, Agent Carmona must rely on him when their shift turns deadly. Between a cartel and corrupt cops, who can you trust?

movies.title: The Girlfriend
movies.synopsis: A college literature student falls for a charming man with a domineering streak, forcing her to confront the toxic truth of his desire.

movies.title: Crime Patrol: 26 Jurm, 26 Cases
movies.synopsis: From disturbing murder cases to gripping investigations, follow police officers as they delve into the most violent crimes that plague society.

episodes.title: 12-04-2025 Aakhri Call
episodes.description: Months after a young woman's death, five students receive calls from her number. But the case turns murky when a decapitated body is found on campus.

episodes.title: 13-04-2025 Hotel Blood Stone
episodes.description: After missing for 10 days, a woman appears in a disturbing video taken at Hotel Blood Stone. Will the police be able to track her down in time?

episodes.title: 19-04-2025 Ek Kaatil, 15000 DNA
episodes.description: When a woman named Naina is found dead, police question those living in her housing complex. Soon, a criminal web begins to unravel.

episodes.title: 20-04-2025 48 Ghante, Tukdo Mein Sach
episodes.description: When the founder of an insurance company goes missing, the mystery deepens when his wife hands over a suspicious video to the police.

episodes.title: 26-04-2025 Garba Mein Maut
episodes.description: An evening of dance turns into a nightmare when Titli, a young girl, is found dead in a supposedly haunted manor. Can the police solve this eerie case?

episodes.title: 27-04-2025 Sard Murder
episodes.description: The discovery of a body inside a restaurant's freezer leads to an intricate case involving a suspicious wife, an online lover and a host of dark secrets.

episodes.title: 03-05-2025 Mitti Mein Dafan Sach
episodes.description: When a skeleton is found buried in a garden, a murder investigation begins as the police question the house's former residents and its secretive staff.

episodes.title: 04-05-2025 Slimming Pills, Bloody Kills
episodes.description: The kidnapping of a popular actor sends the police on a 24-hour mission to find him. But soon, scandal and family ties expose complications in the case.

episodes.title: 10-05-2025 Ratna
episodes.description: The police investigate a horrific scene involving an alleged suicide, a dead teen, masked intruders and a missing girl. How will they solve this case?

episodes.title: 11-05-2025 Charu
episodes.description: Charu, a young woman who cares for the elderly, is murdered on her way home from work. The police retrace her steps to solve this brutal crime.

movies.title: Kara
movies.synopsis: Dhanush ("Idli Kadai") stars as Kara, a desperate thief seeking a new life who turns to robbing banks to save his family's land from predatory lenders.

movies.title: Chumbak
movies.synopsis: Five families support one another through strained marriages, neighborly conflicts and unlikely friendships in this heartwarming comedy series.
movies.creator: Aatish Kapadia, Jamnadas Majethia

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: When Kuku goes missing, Rajni enlists her eccentric neighbors to help find him. But her search soon reveals a frustrating truth about her marriage.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: As Rajni struggles to tell Kuku her decision, the couples across Chumbak Colony reassess their own relationships.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Split over the decision to divorce, Rajni and Kuku seek legal counsel. Dharmendra's unconventional work causes a stir at his daughter's school.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Rajni and Kuku come to an agreement in court. While the men reflect on their marriages, a Bollywood-themed ladies' night goes awry.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: The husbands rush to free their wives from jail as Micky scrambles to hide his affair. Kuku's account of a mystery woman puts Rajni on alert.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Kuku's memory of the elusive woman sparks questions across the colony. Nari organizes a memorial for his beloved pet python.

episodes.title: Episode 7

movies.synopsis: A horror writer visits an Irish inn to scatter his parents' ashes, unaware the property is said to be haunted by a witch.

movies.title: Kurla to Vengurla
movies.synopsis: Set in the beautiful beach town of Vengurla, three couples are torn between two choices. While some want to move to the big city of Mumbai for work, others want to stay close to their village roots. As love, family and dreams come together, each couple must find their own way to make their relationships work.

movies.title: My Dearest Nemesis
movies.synopsis: In 2000, Su-jeong meets her first love "Black Flame Dragon" in an online game-only to find he's a real middle schooler with childish fantasies and dorky fashion. Ten years later, her younger new boss looks oddly familiar. Could he be the very "Black Flame Dragon" she left behind in that game?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: At nineteen, Su-jeong lives frantically in place of her late mother. In a game she tries by chance, she meets her first love, "Black Flame Dragon"-but it becomes her life's biggest embarrassment. Sixteen years later, now a Yongseong Department Store team leader, she faces the new director, Ju-yeon.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Su-jeong tries to mend her rocky start with Ju-yeon, but it isn't easy. To Ju-yeon, who has a secret he'd rather hide, she's nothing but a thorn in his side. Then things flip when Su-jeong catches Ju-yeon in his private life.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Led by Ju-yeon, a large-scale renovation project begins at Yongseong. Working together, Ju-yeon and Su-jeong grow closer, and as she comes to understand him, his heart begins to open-until something makes him lose faith in her.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: The "secret room" finally opens. When a sudden emergency leaves Su-jeong relying on Ju-yeon, his new side keeps making her smile. Meanwhile, because of Ha-jin, Sin-won finds himself doing things he's never done before.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.description: Ha-jin spots Su-jeong and Ju-yeon together and must pull them apart before they realize each other's identities. Her sabotage plan even ropes in Sin-won-leading Ju-yeon to wrongly think Su-jeong is interested in Sin-won.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.description: Why on earth did they kiss? Flustered by last night's events, Su-jeong expects Ju-yeon to confess or explain, but he says nothing. Troubled, she decides to go on a blind date arranged through Ha-jin.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.description: Ju-yeon makes no secret of his feelings for Su-jeong, but with "younger man" a painful memory, she pushes him away however she can. Meanwhile, Ju-yeon is at risk of having his secret exposed by Hyo-seon.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.description: Their feelings finally confirmed, Su-jeong and Ju-yeon begin a precarious secret romance. Hiding it from everyone, they're happy just to be together-so why this sense of dread? Meanwhile, Sin-won and Ha-jin cross paths at a wedding.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.description: "Strawberry" and "Black Flame Dragon" meet again. Old wounds resurface, and the rift between Su-jeong and Ju-yeon deepens. Just when it seems over, a scandal about the two breaks out to make things worse.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.description: "Dismissed and abandoned by Hyo-seon, Ju-yeon ends up alone. Hiding the crisis facing her, Su-jeong strives for his sake. Meanwhile, Ha-jin's ex-husband shows up at the bar.

movies.title: Carrie
movies.synopsis: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

movies.title: Your Fault (Culpa Tuya)
movies.synopsis: Sequel to the global hit My Fault; the love between Noah and Nick seems unwavering despite their parents’ attempts to separate them. But his job and her entry into college open up their lives to new relationships that will shake the foundations of both their relationship and the Leister family itself. When so many people are ready to destroy a relationship, can it really end well?

movies.title: Sita Ramam
movies.synopsis: Afreen, a rebellious Pakistani student sets ablaze the car of an Indian in London. Refused to apologize, Afreen is asked to return 1 Million in 1 month. Angered Afreen comes back to Pakistan to get the money from her grandfather. The late grandfather assigns a letter delivering task to Afreen, written by Ram to Sita. Afreen sets out to find Ram and gradually unveils the story of Sita and Ram.

movies.title: Khalifa
movies.synopsis: A man becomes entangled in a complex world of revenge, heritage and influence amid gold smuggling operations.

movies.title: Dupahiya
movies.synopsis: Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

episodes.title: AG OG Lo Ji 5G
episodes.description: The winter winds bring new chaos to Dhadakpur! Roshni struggles with her SSC prep, Bhugol seeks divine intervention to become a hero and Banwari's hopes come crashing down with a 5G mobile tower! Amavas once again arrives with a scheme for Roshni- will she succumb to a short cut? It's 7 days to go for Roshni's exam!

episodes.title: Gurudakshina
episodes.description: Banwari is determined to get the mobile tower up- by hook or by crook. Bhugol picks Roshni to champion her dreams, only to get pulled into a risky scheme. Amavas spirals as he fumbles with a girl who likes him. Mithlesh zeroes in on his next big case. It's 6 days to go for Roshni's exam!

episodes.title: Hastakshar
episodes.description: Mithlesh's investigation leads him to Pratham Kumar, closing in on the scam. The Jha family's risky efforts finally pay off-and Banwari hands Roshni the precious fees. But just as things seem to fall into place, Pushpalata discovers that the Jha family has stabbed her in the back! It's 5 days to go for Roshni's exam!

episodes.title: Khaki Wala Gunda
episodes.description: Banwari's tower work sparks a village showdown as Pushpalata leads a dramatic protest. Bhugol senses the tension between Amavas and Roshni isn't just about the exam. Mithlesh uncovers a deeper nexus in the cheating scam. Roshni is set to collect the paper-but chaos erupts at a midnight raid. It's 4 days to go for Roshni's exam!

episodes.title: Prem Tribhuj
episodes.description: Mithlesh gets his hands on a crucial clue. Desperate to get the villagers and Pushpalata off his land, Banwari turns to an unlikely ally. Bhugol is convinced there's a love triangle brewing, even as Amavas takes a deadly risk for Roshni. Meanwhile, Mithlesh connects the dots and inches closer. It's 3 days to go for Roshni's exam!

episodes.title: Double Engine
episodes.description: Mithlesh recruits Bhugol, Roshni, and Amavas for a risky undercover mission. Bhugol secretly plots his escape to Mumbai. Meanwhile, Pushpalata flips the power game in a dramatic fashion. At Gyan Buniyaad, Roshni is introduced to her "bogie." Just 2 days to go for Roshni's exam!

episodes.title: Bloody Beauty
episodes.description: Roshni comes face-to-face with Kuber-he humiliates her, but she won't back down. The mission is now colored with revenge. Banwari is arrested; Bhugol breaks, then does the unthinkable to save him. Mithlesh is sidelined. The Dupahiya is found-but completely dismantled. A few hours to go before Roshni's exam!

episodes.title: Pareeksha
episodes.description: Roshni and Bhugol reach the exam center; Kuber refuses to enter without the Dupahiya. Chaos erupts, but Mithlesh finally gets his hands on the mastermind. Bhugol and Banwari resolve their differences, while Pushpalata's confidence in winning the upcoming election is threatened-just as tension between Roshni and Amavas rises

movies.title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
movies.synopsis: After a kind gesture and seeing how untidy her neighbor and classmate is, Mahiru thanks Amane by making sure he lives properly with a clean house and home-cooked meals. Such a generous way to show her appreciation for that rainy day Amane lent her an umbrella. This is the story of a sweet if somewhat vexing romance between a boy and the girl next door.

episodes.title: Going to School Together and Making a Debut
episodes.description: Now officially dating, Amane and Mahiru surprise their classmates when they go public with their relationship.

episodes.title: The Start of Summer Vacation
episodes.description: Amane and Mahiru discuss their feelings and then spend a day at the pool, where Mahiru debuts a new swimsuit.

episodes.title: Homecoming, and Revealing the Relationship
episodes.description: While visiting Amane's parents, Mahiru learns about Amane's youth and Amane runs into a figure from his past.

episodes.title: A Stay-at-Home Date with the Angel
episodes.description: The family goes shopping and then Amane and Mahiru have a date at home when rain spoils their plans to go out.

episodes.title: A Summer Festival with the Angel
episodes.description: After returning from their visit to Amane's hometown, Amane takes Mahiru out to see her first summer festival.

episodes.title: A Once-Desired, Now Undesired Meeting, and a Resolution
episodes.description: Amane and Mahiru discuss their options when a man from Mahiru's past unexpectedly shows up at their building.

episodes.title: The Angel's Pleas
episodes.description: Mahiru and Amane talk about next steps as they get ready for the culture festival and their class's maid café.

episodes.title: Culture Festival, Day One
episodes.description: Mahiru and Amane get a lot of attention dressed up for their maid and butler cafe during the school festival.

episodes.title: The Angel's Request
episodes.description: Amane's parents visit the school festival and Itsuki explains why his father is unwilling to accept Chitose.

episodes.title: An Important Promise with the Angel
episodes.description: Amane worries about taking proper responsibility before he and Mahiru embark on a more intimate relationship.

movies.title: O romeo
movies.synopsis: What fate awaits a stone-hearted gangster, a bloodthirsty womaniser, when true love claims him, helpless and unguarded- a gang war that shakes the entire underworld and crime syndicate to their very roots. A forbidden love - the tale of an unrequited passion.

movies.title: Drawn Together
movies.synopsis: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastián Moore as her bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites between them in a world where nothing is as it seems. Based on the novel by Mercedes Ron, author of the Culpables saga.

At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor's son to make a bet with her about their future!
