episodes.description: A recently dumped budding paleobotanist finds herself reincarnated as a background character in an otome game.

episodes.title: Tea Party with the Love Interests
episodes.description: Fourteen-year-old Pia gets a royal opportunity to make new friends despite her fiancé's overprotective nature.

movies.title: Kusunoki's Garden of Gods
movies.synopsis: Minato Kusunoki is assigned to manage his family's haunted, abandoned countryside estate. However, thanks to his overwhelming spiritual power, Minato accidentally purifies the entire place, turning the once-cursed property into a peaceful haven for wandering gods and deities! As Minato settles in, he finds himself surrounded by quirky divine neighbors and the lively chaos of life among the gods.

episodes.title: A Mountain God Visits the Garden of Gods
episodes.description: Kusunoki Minato discovers that he has a mysterious power when a mountain god pays him a visit.

episodes.title: The Shrine in the Mountain and the Sacred Tree in the Garden
episodes.description: Minato plants the seeds received from Reiki, a divine tortoise, and more gods start to visit his garden.

episodes.title: Training Wind Power in the Sacred Ground
episodes.description: Ichijo comes to bother Minato. Meanwhile, Minato goes to a special location to train his wind power.

episodes.title: Off to the Other World to Exorcise the Evil Spirit
episodes.description: Minato goes to the other world to purify an evil spirit inside a doll, who turns out to be…?

episodes.title: The Kami Realm of Goddess and the Power to Seal Things
episodes.description: Minato receives new power from Amaterasu for helping her.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Spring Garden
episodes.description: While Minato trains to master his new power, a couple of new visitors appear at his residence.

episodes.title: The Key to Unlocking the Power is in the Memories
episodes.description: The memory of the mysterious man helps Minato master the power to seal things.

episodes.title: Ancient Connection with the Neighboring Mountain
episodes.description: Minato meets Tenko, the god of the neighboring mountain, who seems to have a history with Yamagami.

episodes.title: Uninvited Guests While Walking Around Town
episodes.description: Minato takes Yamagami out to cheer him up. Meanwhile, unwanted guests show up at the Kusunoki residence.

episodes.title: Unsolicited Training with a Raging God
episodes.description: Susano'o, a little brother of Amaterasu, visits Minato to train him.

movies.title: Rise And Fall
movies.synopsis: Rise & Fall is a high-stakes reality show that explores the timeless struggle between the powerful & the powerless, the haves & the have nots, bringing to life the harsh contrasts of wealth, privilege, & survival. In this unique social experiment, contestants are divided into two factions - THE RULERS & THE WORKERS.

episodes.title: Let The Games Begin
episodes.description: The game begins with 15 celebrities entering Rise and Fall Season 2, where audience votes determine their auction value. With ₹4 lakh, ₹3.5 lakh and ₹75,000 at stake, players must form partnerships to secure the luxurious Penthouse, while others face the Basement. Rivalries, friendships and unexpected partnerships emerge as the first players take their positions.

episodes.title: Kiski Palti Kismat?
episodes.description: Old rivalries ignite and tempers flare between Swara and Shehzad. Host Sehwag throws a googly which puts all contestants’ fate in the tower on the line. And an ill willed jibe brings about a verbal face off between Siwet and Priyanka.

episodes.title: Lafda Loading..
episodes.description: What begins as a heated exchange between Siwet and Shehzad soon takes an unexpected turn, leaving the Penthouse stunned and the Workers watching in disbelief. As emotions run high and the situation escalates, the Lift steps in with a shocking announcement. What exactly happened inside the Penthouse?

episodes.title: Hurt Kar Diya
episodes.description: The game heats up as tensions rise between the Penthouse and Basement. Amid shifting loyalties and high-stakes decisions, Gautam and Priyanka find themselves on opposite sides of a heated argument. What starts as a difference of opinion quickly turns personal, leaving Priyanka stunned by Gautam’s words. With emotions running high, is their equation about to change?

episodes.title: Gold Digger Hai Tu
episodes.description: Emotions run high as tensions between Priyanka and Shehzad take centre stage, leaving the Penthouse shaken. Meanwhile, the race for ultimate power enters a crucial phase, with Workers and Rulers facing a challenging new task. Friendships are tested, loyalties are questioned and one wrong move could completely change the game.

episodes.title: Majdoor Pe Atyachar Karenge?
episodes.description: The Workers face a demanding Prize Pot Challenge, where every decision could impact their hard-earned pot. Tensions explode when Manish and Tej Pratap Yadav lock horns over a crucial moment, while pressure mounts across the Basement. With the stakes rising and every cracker counting, will the Workers manage to increase their prize pot?

episodes.title: Do Bhai, Dono Tabahi!
episodes.description: Tej Pratap Yadav and Shehzad find themselves stronger than ever as a high-stakes task brings them together. With the Rulers watching and the Workers fighting for their chance, the pressure is on to deliver. From fitness to performance and mimicry, every challenge demands something different. Will this duo conquer the task or face an unexpected twist?

episodes.title: Naagin Vs Nevla
episodes.description: Priyanka and Shehzad's heated equation adds fresh tension to the Penthouse, while Workers get one shot to impress the Ultimate Ruler. With music, dance, mimicry and entertainment on the cards, every performance could make the difference. As the race for the first Rise intensifies, who will steal the spotlight?

episodes.title: Teju Bhaiya Dulhania Le Jayenge
episodes.description: Sehwag puts the Rulers and Workers under the spotlight as the first Rise sparks a fresh debate. Meanwhile, an unexpected gesture puts Gautam in a spot, while the first elimination reaches its biggest moment yet. With the final decision in the Rulers’ hands, one question hangs over the tower: who will face the Ultimate Fall?

episodes.title: Aa Ab Maidaan Mein
episodes.description: The fallout from the first elimination fuels fresh tension as Gautam and Priyanka lock horns. But the real game begins on the Fortune Floor, where two Rulers face a pressure-packed decision with the prize pot ticking down. One choice could shake the Penthouse and flip the power balance. Who will dare to take the risk?

movies.title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles
movies.synopsis: After Rio's mother passed at a young age, he learned to fend for himself as an orphan on the streets. He awakens one day with the memories of Haruto Amakawa, a young student who died in an accident. Rio helps solve a kidnapping case and is rewarded by being granted acceptance into an academy for aristocrats where he must accept the memories of both of his pasts to succeed.

episodes.title: When I Met You in This World, You Were...
episodes.description: Just after rescuing Celia from her wedding, Rio witnesses six pillars of light. He heads towards them at Aishia's behest and finds three people he never imagined meeting in his world... and they need his help!

episodes.title: Shopping in Another World
episodes.description: Rio takes Celia and Miharu to Amande to buy some daily necessities. At first, Miharu is bewildered by the strangeness of being in another world, but soon she's enjoying the trip. Meanwhile, in the Beltrum Kingdom, a Hero appears before Princess Flora.

episodes.title: My Home, Under Attack
episodes.description: Rio returns to the Village of the Spirits with a request. While he's there, Latifa has a quiet moment with him. Elsewhere, Liselotte goes to Sakata with an invitation to a royal party. Meanwhile, Miharu and the others are attacked by monsters!

episodes.title: Welcome Home
episodes.description: Rio brings Miharu and the others from his old world to the Village of Spirits, where they receive safe shelter. To welcome the visitors, the villagers are preparing a grand festival.

episodes.title: Heroes and Champions
episodes.description: Liselotte had to make an emergency landing with her airship due to a dragon and decides to continue her journey by land. At that moment, the hero Hiroaki offers to accompany her.

episodes.title: Lynchpin of Memories
episodes.description: After saving Liselotte's group, Rio hides his identity from them by saying his name is Haruto. Still, Flora senses something familiar in him. Meanwhile, Aki remembers the sad day when she was separated from her older brother.

episodes.title: Intruders
episodes.description: Rio rejoins Celia and Aishia in Amande. They go out to dine in a private room at a restaurant. Then Alphonse bursts in with his friends and demands they get out. Not wanting trouble, Rio and the others move to leave, but Alphonse blocks their way!

episodes.title: The Clutches of Evil, Stealing Ever Closer
episodes.description: As the knights investigate the forest, they are attacked and subdued in a flash. When Alphonse wakes, he witnesses a horrible sight. Meanwhile, Flora's thoughts of Haruto overlap with memories of Rio. Her swirling emotions keep her awake.

episodes.title: The Battle to Defend Amande
episodes.description: Amande is attacked by monsters, plunging the townspeople into chaos and fear. Liselotte deploys her attendants to help limit the damage, and Rio goes to the east gate to help. Meanwhile, Lucius and the revenants swiftly approach their target.

episodes.title: Destined Enemy
episodes.description: Revenants attack the room where Sakata, Flora, and the others have taken shelter. Sakata leaps into action and Flora manages to flee into the hallway, but there are other dangers lying in wait. Rio notices something wrong and pursues it alone.

movies.title: The Traitors (Telugu)
movies.synopsis: Hosted by Teja Sajja, The Traitors is a brutal game of betrayal where 20 contestants face daily eliminations for a grand prize. Hidden among the innocent players are the traitors, striking to murder each night. In this high-stakes battlefield of trust, deception, and strategy - Trust is Uncool, Mosam Ikkada New Rule. New episodes every Thursday.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Twenty celebrity players enter a magnificent palace to begin the ultimate psychological game of trust and betrayal. But three among them are secretly chosen by Teja Sajja as Traitors. As the players form their first alliances and take on their opening mission, the Traitors prepare for their first murder in the Traitor Den.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: After the first murder, the players realise just how dangerous the game is. A new mission introduces game-changing Shields that could protect the Innocents from the Traitors. Can they earn one - and strike back in the Ring of Doubt?

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: The Traitors have the upper hand. A ruthless mission puts Shields up for grabs, with the power to protect the Innocents from the Traitors' wrath. Alliances crack, suspicions explode, and the Ring of Doubt becomes a battleground.

movies.title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
movies.synopsis: Ken Usato, an ordinary high school student, is transported to another world with his classmates Suzune Inukami and Kazuki Ryusen. Suzune and Kazuki are summoned as heroes to fight the Demon Lord's army, while Usato is accidentally brought along. Discovering Usato's talent for healing magic, Rose, the Rescue Squad leader, forcibly takes him for intense training. ©KUROKATA/MF Books/HM PROJECT

episodes.title: Dragged Into Another World!
episodes.description: Ordinary high school student Usato is suddenly summoned to another world with Suzune, the student council president, and Kazuki. They are tasked with saving the Llinger Kingdom as heroes, but Usato was summoned by accident. Everything changes when Usato's healing magic talent is discovered, and Rose, the Rescue Squad captain, takes him for intense training.

episodes.title: The Beginning of Hell!
episodes.description: Usato, now a member of the Rescue Squad, immediately begins his hellish training with Rose. Just when he lets his guard down after finishing his first day of training, he is forced to do nothing but run. As Usato continues to train while Rose heals his sore muscles with magic, his body gradually begins to change.

episodes.title: Ruthless! The Darkness of Llinger!
episodes.description: Thrown into the monster-infested "Darkness of Llinger" by Rose, Usato tries to survive as he attempts to hunt a Grand Grizzly. At first, Usato is overwhelmed by the Grand Grizzly. However, as he continues to observe it, he gradually grows attached to it. A few days later, when Usato finally resolves to kill the Grand Grizzly, he witnesses a horrific scene.

episodes.title: Usato, Rescue Squad Member!
episodes.description: Usato learns that war with the Demon Lord's Army is near and doubts he can fight like Rose. Training with Blurin, a Blue Grizzly cub he found in the "Darkness of Llinger," he meets fellow healer Orga in the castle town. After their chat, Usato becomes more determined as a member of the Rescue Squad.

episodes.title: Usato, into the Forest Again!
episodes.description: Usato is assigned to accompany Suzune in her training. However, together with the knight Aruku and mage Korin, they encounter bandits. While they are able to fend off the bandits without much difficulty, a horde of Fall Boars attack. Usato and Suzune are blown away into the "Darkenss of Llinger" and are forced to survive in the wilderness.

episodes.title: Danger Approaches…!
episodes.description: Usato and Suzune report their safe return from the "Darkness of Llinger" to King Lloyd. Sensing something amiss from the unusual monsters, King Lloyd orders Rose to scout the area. Rose discovers the Demon Lord's Army preparing for invasion. Meanwhile, Usato visits Orga and Ururu's clinic and joins them at an accident scene.

episodes.title: The Night of Resolve!
episodes.description: Usato is puzzled by the disturbing visions shown to him by the beastman girl Amako. At night, when he is unable to sleep because of his concern, mysterious balls of light appear outside his window. Lured by the balls of light, he looks outside and sees Kazuki. Kazuki begins to share his feelings with Usato, admitting that he is afraid to stand on the battlefield as a hero.

episodes.title: Battalion Commander Rose
episodes.description: Five years ago, Rose, a battalion commander of Llinger Kingdom, led an eccentric unit, including her second-in-command, Owl. Ordered on a reconnaissance mission into the "Darkness of Llinger," Rose and her team reaffirm their bonds. The next morning, they encounter a mysterious group of demons transporting monsters, including one with an unusual aura.

episodes.title: The End and the Beginning
episodes.description: Rose's men and the Demon Lord's Army cross swords in the "Darkness of Llinger." Just as Rose and her men manage to gain the upper hand, Nero, a general of the Demon Lord's Army, orders his own men to attack without concern for their own lives. One by one, Rose's men are killed as they take each other out. Nero continues to attack Rose, who is fraught with anger and has lost her composure.

episodes.title: Madness?! The Black Knight Appears!
episodes.description: The war against the Demon Lord's Army has begun. Usato treats the wounded, witnessing the battlefield's harshness. As the war progresses, Usato and Rose move to the front lines. Using his well-trained abilities, Usato saves the kingdom's knights amid the enemy onslaught. Meanwhile, Suzune and Kazuki, fighting as heroes, face a mysterious demon known as the Black Knight.

movies.title: Neagley
movies.synopsis: From the world of REACHER, a new chapter begins. Frances Neagley (Maria Sten) is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher (Alan Ritchson) in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

episodes.title: L Train
episodes.description: When Neagley's childhood friend, Tommy, dies after walking into an oncoming train, the police are ready to label this as an apparent accident. But after receiving a mysterious message from the deceased, Neagley knows something is amiss.

episodes.title: Team Building Exercises
episodes.description: With Neagley's investigation into the suspicious death of her childhood friend, Tommy Crane, hitting countless roadblocks, a long-buried secret from Neagley's past threatens to upend everything she once knew of her childhood.

episodes.title: Hammer Time
episodes.description: After an ambush turns up her best break in the case thus far, Neagley is blindsided by local law enforcement's attempts to sideline her.

episodes.title: Breaking & Entering
episodes.description: Neagley's investigation into Tommy's death has drawn the focus of powerful enemies - putting herself and her team in danger.

episodes.title: Trip
episodes.description: Hidden truths from Neagley's past come rushing to the forefront, forcing her to rely on her newfound team more than ever.

episodes.title: Rocked
episodes.description: With new evidence coming to light, Neagley realizes she is not only responsible for solving Tommy's murder, but countless others as well.

episodes.title: Lebron's No Jordan
episodes.description: As clues dry up, Hudson is forced to make a devil's bargain to keep the case from going cold.

episodes.title: Touched
episodes.description: With the legacy of her deceased childhood friend on the line, and the lives of her team under threat, Neagley mounts one last stand to bring Tommy's killers to justice.

movies.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You
movies.synopsis: Rentaro Aijo was rejected 100 times in middle school. He visits a shrine and prays for better luck in high school. The God of Love appears and promises that he'll soon meet 100 people he's destined to date. But there's a catch-once destiny introduces someone to him, the two must happily love each other. If they don't, they'll die. What will befall Rentaro and his 100 girlfriends in high school?

episodes.title: Cousin and Girlfriend
episodes.description: A reporter asks about love at the shopping mall where Rentaro and some of the girls are.

episodes.title: Chiyo's Family Coaching
episodes.description: Rentaro introduces his new girlfriend to the family as always, but she's shocked by the state of affairs.

episodes.title: The Japanese Teacher Has Blonde Hair
episodes.description: The new Japanese teacher seems obsessed... with the United States?

episodes.title: The Rentaro Family Idol Legend
episodes.description: The Rentaro Family has to take the stage at the school fest as pinch-hitters. Can they really pull this off?

episodes.title: Yasashiki-san's Gardening Club Tour
episodes.description: Rentaro gets the idea to gift flower crowns to his girlfriends, and who better to ask than the gardening club?

episodes.title: Momiji-chan's Squishy Festival
episodes.description: Rentaro seeks out a rumored masseuse to help his surely exhausted girlfriends.

episodes.title: Thumbelinano and the Kusurivanian Family
episodes.description: Nano is nano-fied for a day, and Rentaro is summoned by Kusuri's dad to explain himself.

episodes.title: Kusuri-Senpai's Grandmother
episodes.description: While visiting Kusuri's home, Rentaro feels the sparks fly with her grandmother! Is this really going to fly?

episodes.title: Hardcore Hot Springs Hopping with a Chance of Heaven
episodes.description: The Rentaro Family gets a special invite to a new relaxation facility, but the trip is anything but relaxing!

episodes.title: The Rise and Fall of the Proud Girlfriend
episodes.description: Rentaro introduces the gallant Kishika to the family, and she breaks the ice in the way only she knows.

movies.title: B.A. Pass
movies.synopsis: Orphaned and at loose ends, a young boy falls into the seductive orbit of a married woman, who leads him even deeper into a world of sex and betrayal.

movies.title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
movies.synopsis: Sato may be the most beautiful girl in school but she's also the coldest, never smiling at anyone. When her classmate Oshio spots her at a café, he learns Sato's secret: she's actually just shy and clumsy. As Sato and Oshio bond over their shared interests in photography and desserts, a sweet romance starts to blossom between two socially awkward people.

episodes.title: The Cold Sato-San
episodes.description: Sota encounters Koharu, who is known as the "Cold Sato-san," at his family's cafe where he works part-time.

episodes.title: A Second First Love
episodes.description: Koharu invites Sota to learn how to capture Minstagram-worthy photos at popular places.

movies.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
movies.synopsis: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates' gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.

episodes.title: Everyone knows what it's like when nothing goes right, but what do I do when that happens? Why, it's obvious! I run and scream my head off!
episodes.description: Rein is unceremoniously kicked out of the Beast's Fangs, so he decides to become an adventurer.

movies.title: Cocoons 2026
movies.synopsis: In a typical Rayalaseema Telugu village, three young friends daydream about their future without taking practical responsibility. When they come across an opportunity to make easy money during local rural elections, they end up cheating the public as well as their own families. When reality strikes, they realize the moral and practical consequences of their actions.

movies.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
movies.synopsis: Ars Louvent reincarnates as a child of a minor noble family. Ars lacks special intelligence or martial prowess, he has "Appraisal Skill," allowing to see others' abilities and statuses. With this skill, he uncovers hidden "talents" in the world and strengthen his domain. ©MiraijinA, KODANSHA/ “As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World” Production Committee.

episodes.title: Episode 1 Reincarnation and Appraisal
episodes.description: Ars reincarnates in a another world as the son of a minor noble family, having the innate skill of "appraisal" to discern people's abilities. He ventures into the town in search of talented individuals. There, he encounters Rietz, a young boy from Marcan who is lost and discriminated against. Through his appraisal, Ars discovers that Rietz has flawless and overwhelming stats.

episodes.title: Episode 2 Upper and Lower Class
episodes.description: Following Raven's orders, Ars, along with Rietz , begin searching for talents. Seeking new encounters, Ars visits Cannare and is impressed by its developed streets. But, he notices striking disparities between rich and poor, which offers him a guide for future development. Ars unexpectedly meet a girl, Charlotte, and discovers that she has extraordinary magical talents.

episodes.title: Episode 3 Answer
episodes.description: Ars, accompanied by Reitz, head to rescue Charlotte, who had been captured by slave traders. By Reitz's efforts, they successfully rescue Charlotte from the hands of the rogues. Hearing Ars’ goal of "creating a city where children can hold onto hope," Charlotte finally pledges her loyalty to him.

episodes.title: Episode 4 Where Talents Are
episodes.description: By the time Ars turns six years old, Reitz and Charlotte are already showing remarkable prowess. While searching for the next talent, they hear rumors of a pair of gifted hunter brothers. Upon visiting them, they encounter the youngest brother, a timid boy named Rosell. Using appraisal skills, they discover that he has extraordinary ""strategic prowess"".

episodes.title: Episode 5 The Storm is coming!
episodes.description: While steadily developing the strongest territory, Ars's father, Raven, suddenly fall ill. As Raven lays bedridden, he reveals to Ars for the first time about a bethrothal. With no time to prepare, Ars' fiancée, Licia, arrives at the Louvent household. Licia is an undeniably lovely girl, but Ars notices a significant "ambition" hidden within her, using his appraisal skills.

episodes.title: Episode 6 The Face of the Warrior
episodes.description: As Raven's condition gradually worsens, shocking news arrives that the governor of Misian state, where Ars is, has been assassinated. Instead of his ill father, Ars responds to the summons of Canal County Chief Lumere and attends the military council. Lumere informs them that a major war is imminent, and Ars and his companions brace themselves for it.

episodes.title: Episode 7 Inheritance
episodes.description: Ars, who is not allowed by Raven to go to the battlefield, struggles to become stronger. However, the time for him to part with his father is approaching rapidly. Knowing his fate, Raven entrustes Ars to Rietz, Charlotte, Rosell, and Licia. On the night of the full moon, Ars and Raven spend their last moments as father and son.

episodes.title: Episode 8 New Genaration
episodes.description: A trial soon befalls Ars, the new lord of Lamberg. To secure alliance with Plena, Ars' team set out to devise a strategy. To ensure their success, they seek assistance of the mercenary group, "The Shadows," known for their excellent information-gathering skills.

episodes.title: Episode 9 Searching Intentions
episodes.description: Ars' team, aiming to sway Plena, acquire a pact from the enemy by Famme's efforts. However, the document contains puzzling elements. Noticing this, Rosell devises a plan using the pact. Ars' team directly enter Plena and expose the 'lies' written in the pact, waking the county chief to conscience who had defected to the enemy.

episodes.title: Episode 10 Couran Salemakhia
episodes.description: Invited by Couran, the successor to the governor, Ars' team head to the trading city of Semplar. As Ars feels nervous about the grand party, Couran finally makes an appearance. During the rally party, Couran speaks of his ambition to found the "Nation of Missian" and praises Ars. However, he also reveals the pressing issue of insufficient manpower in their force.

movies.title: Overgeared
movies.synopsis: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

episodes.title: Legendary Class
episodes.description: Grid hopes to strike it rich in the VR game Satisfy. While taking on an S-Ranked quest, he discovers Pagma's Tome.

movies.title: Waiting Hai
movies.synopsis: A story of the world's largest railway ticketing scam, Tatkal follows two youth on the opposite end of the law. Afroz Hamza, the mastermind is chased by cop Sugam Mishra, who is determined to bring the entire racket down.

episodes.title: Kitty Tere Pyaar Mein
episodes.description: Naive young man Sugam moves to Patna with his newly wed wife Princy to join the RPF. His first day doesn't go as planned as his senior officer belittles and bullies him, saying he got the job because of his slain father. In another part of the city, impoverished young guy Hamza fails to impress his love of life, but hacks the railway website and gets her a confirmed train ticket.

episodes.title: Scam Ho Gaya Bihar Mein
episodes.description: Sugam and Princy struggle to keep their new marriage afloat with Amma's constant presence. At work, Sugam is given duty as dog handler for local super star Sajjan Kumar's visit, but things go haywire when the dog, a senior ranking cop than Sugam, runs away. Hamza expresses his love, but the girl complains to the principal. Mama learns he hacked the railway website and decides to monetise it.

episodes.title: Yatrigan Kripya Dhyaan Dein
episodes.description: Sugam's Amma decides to go back to their village. Excited to start a fresh romantic life with Princy, Sugam tries to book tickets but finds none available in Tatkal. Hamza and Mama spread their software to local agents and get a percentage share. They later realize Bhoora is keeping the bigger chunk. When they confront him, he beats them up.

episodes.title: Ek Bihaari Sau Pe Bhaari
episodes.description: Sugam is given the duty of a runner by his senior as revenge for acting smart and flouting orders. But Sugam uses this opportunity to investigate into the Tatkal case. He befriends local tout Bauwa and, with the help of GRP, arrests 200 plus agents, making him a local star. Meanwhile, Hamza and Mama hack into Bhoora's operations, leading to his arrest.

episodes.title: Sawaari Samaan Ki Khud Zimmedaar
episodes.description: Sugam gets appreciation from the DRM for the arrests. The DRM announces a new rule - only 4 tickets can be booked from an account in one day to curb illegal booking. Hamza figures the flaw - there is no curb on Tickets per IP address. With the help of local trans-women, he realizes a network can be formed and the business can grow pan India. Dada dies, but not before telling him to be successful.

episodes.title: Gale Laga Le Koi
episodes.description: Sugam finally gets to go for his honeymoon. When he returns to Patna, he realizes the ticket issue persists. Hamza and Mama travel across the country with the DRM taking a 50 percent cut, but they are kidnapped by a don who demands their 50 percent. Sugam is disheartened. Hamza falls in love again. Mama indulges in alcohol and sex workers.

episodes.title: Relampel
episodes.description: Hamza decides to leave everything and go to Dubai with his new girlfriend. Sugam, with the help of cyber cell and smart police work, tracks down Mama and stumbles upon the work done by trans-women to spread the ticketing software. Mama rats out information on Hamza. After a high-octane chase, Hamza is caught from Patna railway station.

movies.title: Sardar 2
movies.synopsis: When a forgotten mission resurfaces, a new generation of intelligence officers is drawn into a dangerous web of espionage, deception, and betrayal. Haunted by the past, Agent Sardar returns for one final mission as old allies, new enemies, and buried secrets collide. With national security at stake, every choice comes at a price.

movies.title: Awarapan
movies.synopsis: A tragic love story of a hitman Shivam, who unable to forgive himself for the death of his old lover, starts working for a gangster Malik. Impressed by his loyalty and dedication, Malik makes him his right-hand man. But when Malik asks Shivam to keep an eye on his mistress, Shivam goes against his orders and attempts to rescue her from the clutches of his employer even at the cost of his life.

movies.title: Helluva Boss
movies.synopsis: This adult animated comedy follows the misadventures, hijinks, and relationships of the Immediate Murder Professionals (or I.M.P. for short)-- a band of demon assassins from Hell who kill people on Earth for a living.

episodes.title: Turtle Emoji
episodes.description: Stolas sends Blitzo a turtle emoji and things sure do happen.

episodes.title: Bad Reputation
episodes.description: Millie's got a bad reputation and things sure do happen.

episodes.title: Gimpy Gimpy
episodes.description: The gang heads to Australia and things sure do happen.

movies.title: Make Me Tingle
movies.synopsis: A story of two people with opposite views on love-Yeon-su, a Confucian-girl marketer who dates but won't have sex, and Dokgo Dal, an adult-toy company CEO who has sex but won't date-who shake up each other's worlds and come to find real love.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Ultra-conservative Confucian-girl marketer Gong Yeon-su. After breaking up with her boyfriend Seung-jun, in a fit of pique she plunges into adult-toy marketing... And of all people, the client is Dokgo Dal-the blind-date man who saw her at her worst!?

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.description: Yeon-su's first day at Loand. The world of sex toys she meets for the very first time is nothing short of shocking... and she clashes with Dokgo Dal at every turn over their opposing views on sex.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.description: Body first or heart first? Yeon-su and Dokgo Dal, colliding over their different views of love. After a fierce standoff with no concession, the two share an impulsive kiss, and Yeon-su falls into the greatest confusion of her life…

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.description: Loand prepares a random-box event from Yeon-su's idea. Meanwhile, Dokgo Dal, asked by Yeon-su to handle a mission, turns her family upside down with a shockingly blunt remark!

movies.title: Firefly Wedding
movies.synopsis: Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want-except time. With her life running out, she's determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: "Marry me, and we'll have it all." Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.

episodes.title: An Unwanted Repayment
episodes.description: A frail young lady finds herself kidnapped. Her only hope is to win over a man hired to kill her.

movies.title: Heaven Official's Blessing
movies.synopsis: Xie Lian, crown prince of Xian Le Kingdom, ascends to Heaven despite successive demotions. However, he accidentally breaks the Gold Palace of heavenly officials. With no human worshiping him, Xie Lian must descend to the secular world to exorcise ghosts.

episodes.title: The Ghost King Appears
episodes.description: Xie Lian is summoned by Jun Wu to the Heavenly Realm where he's informed that a Heavenly Official needs to be rescued, so he goes to the Ghost Realm, the territory of the dead.

episodes.title: Accidentally Entered a Gambling Den
episodes.description: The Martial God of the East, Lang Qianqiu, causes a commotion in the ghost king's gambling hall, forcing Xie Lian to play a dice game against the king himself, Hua Cheng, to save his comrade.

episodes.title: Ghost Binding Cursed Shackle
episodes.description: A masked ghost leads Xie Lian to the Paradise Manor, where Hua Cheng is waiting for him. Later on, Xie Lian meets the bandaged boy from Yu Jun Mountain again and recalls a similar boy he met eight hundred years ago.

episodes.title: The Secret Chamber
episodes.description: After infiltrating Paradise Manor and using a mysterious door granting access to various spaces depending on dice rolls, Xie Lian and Shi Qingxuan eventually reach the underground dungeon, where they discover the missing Heavenly Official.

episodes.title: Heavenly Palace Raid
episodes.description: Acknowledging his position as the State Preceptor, Xie Lian is apprehended and put under house arrest. He reflects on his haunted past before the doors of the Palace of Xianle are kicked open and silver butterflies swarm in.

episodes.title: A Thousand Miles Away
episodes.description: Hua Cheng leads Xie Lian away from the Heavenly Realm. Meanwhile, Feng Xin and Mu Qing encounter many obstacles while attempting to rescue him, and Lang Qianqiu has a plan of his own.

episodes.title: The Green-Clothed Ghost Qi Rong
episodes.description: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng enter the lair of the Night-Touring Green Lantern, Qi Rong. After a brief, violent confrontation, Qi Rong reveals the truth about the Yong'an massacre but other surprising truths are also told.

episodes.title: Yong An and Xian Le
episodes.description: Hua Cheng loses his composure and begins to violently assault Qi Rong. Qi Rong gives in and reveals the truth about the massacre at the Golden Feast...The truth is revealed about what happened in Yong An, which was supposed to have been heading towards peace, just before Lang Qianqiu was about to have his 17th Birthday...

episodes.title: Bloodstained Banquet
episodes.description: An Le, a descendant of the imperial house of the fallen kingdom of Xian Le, was left in charge of preparations for the Golden Feast by the ruler of Yong An. While on the surface, An Le was a good friend to the Yong An Imperial Family, there was a darkness in his heart that Qi Rong took advantage of. When Fangxin (Xie Lian) arrives late to the banquet, he encounters something shocking, and is ...

episodes.title: A Sad Parting Under Moonlight
episodes.description: Xie Lian gets angry with Hua Cheng for revealing the truth about the Golden Feast Massacre to Lang Qianqiu. But Hua Cheng tells him plainly that Xie Lian did nothing wrong. When he realizes that Hua Cheng trusts him absolutely, and is the one person to see through to the truth of the matter, he says aloud that he wonders if they've met somewhere before...

movies.title: Lenin Pandiyan
movies.synopsis: Set in Manamadurai, an elderly couple gets caught in the dangerous political world of sand mining. A judge assigns a rookie police constable to protect them from a powerful system. As the three form an unexpected bond, they are drawn into a series of incidents that force them to confront the forces of power.

movies.title: Masterplan
movies.synopsis: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him - Chiara, an Italian cybercrime expert and Jay, a French explosives specialist - before revealing he is both their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion, this new family must learn to work together and try not to kill each other if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

movies.title: Jailer
movies.synopsis: Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, a retired jailer, is now a family man who leads an ordinary life. Trouble knocks on his door when his son, a diligent cop, investigates an idol smuggling mafia. And forces Muthuvel Pandian to step back into the dark world of his past.
